chapters.title: Chapter 4639: Actualization IV
paragraphs: In this surreal scene, Noah was shockingly transferring the entire Depth ofTHE Dead Ordertoward Sigrid at impossible speed.
To the extent that within mere femtoseconds, nearly ninety percent of her accumulated authority across eons was siphoned away completely.
Additional glorious prompts manifested.
|Emergence Assessment - Sigrid, The Living Order|
|Sigrid has built sufficient foundation due to your influence of Mana and the siphoned Civilizational Authority of Order|
|Her Foundation is stabilizing rapidly|
|Her establishment of THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty of Order has been deemed INEVITABLE|
|Timeline: Imminent|
|Outcome: Through her and under your guidance, the true Primordial Civilization of Order shall bloom once more|
At this moment, as the last remnants of Order were about to be completely extracted fromTHE Dead Order’scollapsing existence, her torn face managed to roar out with utter horror and desperate rage.
"O CREATURE! SAVE ME! SAVE ME! I USE ONE OF THE PROMISES!"
BOOM!
The moment those words left her ruined mouth, Noah felt an undeniable force descend from outside this space.
It pulled his arms forcibly from her split head.
Her figure became instantly covered and preserved in multicolored flames of Existence.
Vast distances manifested between them as space itself expanded.
He watched as she breathed raggedly with expression mixing horror, shock, and absolute rage toward him.
Her figure appeared weak and feeble and filled with profound misery.
She looked at him while her split forehead attempted desperately to heal.
But when she sensed the extent of her lost power, when she felt the hollow emptiness where her authority had been...
She wailed with voice that shattered the remaining composure she possessed.
"MY ORDER! MY GLORIOUS ORDER! YOU HAVE TAKEN EVERYTHING FROM ME! EVERYTHING! ALL MY EVERYTHINGS! I WANT YOU DEAD! I WANT YOU COLLAPSED INTO NOTHINGNESS!"
Tears of white-gold blood streamed down her face.

"O CREATURE! FOR THE LAST PROMISE! FOR MY FINAL WISH! I WISH FOR THE COMPLETE AND TOTAL COLLAPSE OF OSMONT! IN THIS EXISTENCE, IN YOUR EXISTENCE, HE CANNOT BE ALLOWED TO REMAIN! COLLAPSE HIM! COLLAPSE HIM! COLLAPSE HIM NOW!"
Her screams echoed with desperate finality as she spent her last protection.
The words of THE Dead Order seemed like the ravings of a mad woman.
But she had lost absolutely everything as she had nothing else left to cling to.
Noah’s expression was heavy as he remembered the unstoppable force that had pulled him away from her just moments ago.
Just when he had been about to extract the last remaining waves of authority from her fractured existence.
That unstoppable force and momentum was none other than Existence itself.
It had felt like the very structure of reality around him flared with overwhelming power.
Even musings of The First Tongue had surged to cause absolute and undeniable separation between him andTHE Dead Order.
If that was the result of a single wish from this being, and she now wished for his complete collapse...
His eyes burned with a sense of defiance and lividity once more.
His entire existence became covered by defensive Logos of The First Tongue as he prepared for what might come.
The Phonemes of Void, Darkness, and Paradox wove together to create conceptual shields.
The Phonemes of Unity and Division combined to make his existence both unified against attack and divided enough to survive fragmentation.
The Phoneme of Beginning prepared rapid regeneration if needed.
In the distance, the raving figure ofTHE Dead Orderwailed and cried with voice breaking.
She kept her tear-streaked gaze fixed upon him, desperately waiting to witness his collapse.
Beside Noah, the figure of Sigrid, soon to beTHE Living Orderin full manifestation, moved to stand protectively at his side.
THE Civilizational Authority of Orderflowing through her newly empowered existence began spreading outward.
White-gold streams of authority covered Noah as well, creating additional layers of protection around him.
Her expression showed fierce determination to defend what was hers.
As they all waited with mounting tension for the terrifying response from Existence itself...
No response came.
Silence descended across the space.
The Weavings ofTHE Dead Orderbegan shining with a maddening light of pure lunacy as the silence stretched.
She roared out again with voice cracking from strain and desperation.
"I SAID FOR MY LAST WISH I WISH HIM TO BE COLLAPSED! YOU PROMISED THIS TO ME! WHEN I FELL TO PARADOX, WHEN I LOST EVERYTHING THE FIRST TIME, YOU PROMISED ME! WILL YOU NOT KEEP YOUR PROMISE?!"
Her voice became even more desperate and broken.

"YOU PROMISED ME INFINITY! YOU PROMISED ME HAPPINESS! YOU PROMISED ME RESTORATION! WILL YOU NOT EVEN GIVE ME THAT AMIDST ALL THIS MISERY?! AFTER EVERYTHING I HAVE LOST?! AFTER ALL I HAVE SACRIFICED?!"
She wailed and cried as she spoke the last few words, her entire being trembling with grief and rage.
Tears of white-gold blood continued streaming down her fractured face.
And yet, shockingly, there was still no response from Existence itself.
No force descended to collapse Noah.
No power manifested to fulfill her wish.
Only profound silence answered her desperate pleas.
Moments later, amidst her teary face and wailing Weavings of existence, a different power descended.
Multicolored flames of Existence wrapped aroundTHE Dead Order’sbroken form.
And this unique power began taking her away from this space entirely like cradling a broken child.
Removing her to some unknown location.
It was a unique scene to observe.
Because shockingly, impossibly, THE Creature did not accomplish the wish ofTHE Dead Orderto collapse Noah!
Her final promise, her last desperate request, went unfulfilled.
Why?
The eyes ofTHE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexiconspulsed with Fragments of Phonemes of The First Tongue as he contemplated many possible answers.
HadTHE Creaturedecided Noah was more valuable alive than dead?
Had the closed temporal loop made Noah’s existence somehow essential to maintain?
HadTHE Creaturegained too much from Noah’s actions to risk collapsing him now?
Or was there some other game being played that Noah could not yet perceive?
The questions swirled through his mind as he analyzed the implications.
THE Dead Orderhad not fully collapsed by his hands as he had intended.
But he had obtained all that he truly needed from her.
Ninety percent of her Civilizational Authority now resided in Sigrid.
Enough to forgeTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty for The Living Order.
Enough to restore the true Primordial Civilization of Order under his guidance.
So at this moment, Noah put his hands gently around the waist of Sigrid.
He pulled her close as he spoke with quiet certainty.
"Let’s go."
A moment later, their manifestations in this space between spaces disappeared.
And this manifested space itself, no longer sustained byTHE Dead Order’spresence and authority, began crumbling and folding into nothingness.
The veil that had separated Living and Dead Order dissolved.
The entire constructed reality collapsed back into the fundamental Weavings from which it had been formed.
Leaving only scattered traces of what had occurred here.
And the unanswered question of why THE Creature had refused THE Dead Order’s final wish.

chapters.title: Chapter 4640: Actualization V
paragraphs: Nobody knew the future.
Not truly.
Even those who believed they knew, even those who fooled themselves into thinking they could predict what was coming with certainty, they were only looking at possibilities and potentials.
In Existence, nobody absolutely knew the future with complete certainty.

It was so terrifying and unpredictable that if an entity from the future traveled back and told someone in the past a few specific things that would be happening later on, they would shake their heads in disbelief.
As if they were listening to the words of an absolutely insane person.

If days ago, if a few weeks ago when Noah first met Moiraine in a certain prison after his Weavings led there from being embroiled with Little Bobby’s schemes, when he had only just begun learning aboutTHE Living Existencesfrom her and started listening to the Stories of The Earliest Folds, aboutTHE Creatureand how he supposedly met Origin, Concept, and Paradox in grand encounters...
Which all turned out to be utter bullshit now that he knew the truth.
But if at that time, someone had come to him and said:

"Oh yeah, days from now, you will actually glimpseTHE Creaturein person. You’ll talk withTHE Living Orderand form a connection. You’ll be nearly caught by THELiving Temporalduring temporal traversal. And then somehow, your actions across time will actually causeInfinite Potentialto bloom from a closed temporal loop and allowTHE Living Origin,who was collapsed eons ago, to be coming back to existence. And oh, there’s evenTHE First Hungerreturning alongside her."
If someone had approached Noah back then and told him all of this with complete seriousness, he would have looked at them as if they were absolutely nuts.
As if to ask: how the hell would things somehow evolve and progress to that level of insanity in a matter of mere days or even weeks?
It would have seemed impossible. Utterly incredulous.
Nobody knew the future with certainty.
Nobody knew how things would fully unfold or what paths reality would take.

But the one constant that remained, the one truth that endured, was that the future would unfathomably be glorious in ways that nobody would ever come to understand until they lived it in the present moment.
Things that would have been deemed utterly incredulous and completely unfathomable mere weeks ago were happening right now, in this very instant.
And who knew what things that were considered impossible at this moment in time would be occurring days or weeks from now?
What new impossibilities would become reality?
Noah did not know and could not say with absolute surety.
But at this time, he opened his eyes in that region of collapse once more.
From his people gathered among the armored Primus Inevitabilities, Sigrid took a step and instantly appeared beside him.
Her body continued radiating increasingly grand levels of power.
The aura ofTHEwas slowly building within her existence, becoming more defined and concentrated with each passing moment.
Khor, The First Farmer, Alexander Asmodeus, and all the others couldn’t help but turn to stare with shock.
Such a sudden eruption of power represented far too much immensity to ignore.
But at this time, Noah acted with decisive purpose.
He began weaving together a complex Logos using multiple Core Phonemes of The First Tongue.
The Phoneme of Void to create conceptual emptiness that could not be perceived through.
The Phoneme of Darkness to conceal what occurred within from outside observation.
The Phoneme of Space to establish proper dimensional boundaries.
The Phoneme of Division to separate inside from outside completely.
The Phoneme of Unity to bind all the concealment effects together seamlessly.
The Phoneme of Order to maintain the structure’s integrity.
The Phoneme of Beginning to initiate the isolation.
These seven Phonemes wove together into a Logos of tremendous complexity that most closely translated to: "In void and darkness, space divides and unites with ordered beginning to conceal."
The Logos flowed outward from Noah’s position, expanding rapidly to surround the entire region of collapse.
A blue-gold veil wrapped around this entire area like a crystalline dome.
It ensured that everything happening within would not be visible to entities observing from outside.
It isolated the space entirely so that any authorities erupting here would not be detected by other powers.
Not by THE Living Paradox observing from THE Loom.
Not by any other entities watching for signs of unusual activity.
Even the jailed figures contained in prisons formed with blue-gold bars were moved.
Schrodinger with his broken body.
The Disciple ofTHE Creaturein his cage.
The captured Guiders of Order.
All of them were placed outside of this veiled domain so they could not witness what was about to unfold.
Noah accomplished all of this with immense calmness and methodical precision.
Then he focused his attention on the vibrant trembling singularities of Hunger and Origin floating before him.
He was watching the power of Infinite Potential that his lineage represented begin to show itself fully.
He was witnessing what it truly meant to beTHE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons.
The First Tongue held countless possibilities and wonders as it was the answer to The Fallout and all other existential problems.
And even asTHE Living Paradoxdeemed that it was now five seconds to midnight, Noah’s gaze contained profound defiance.
He would be ready for whatever came.
He WAS ready.
He had himself, who could take downTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentities before he even officially grasped this classification himself.
And he could be considered to have fifteen such entities contained withinTHE Infinite Desmoterionas prisoners contributing to his power!
And to top it all off at this very moment...
Prompts descended before his vision.
|Emergence Sequence - Initiating|
|The Seed of THE First Hunger is actualizing from Infinite Potential|
|The Seed of THE Living Origin is actualizing from Infinite Potential|
|Source: Closed Temporal Loop completing causality cycle|
|Mechanism: Your influence on their Weavings in The Infinite Unfurling preserved in The First Tongue|
|Timeline: Immediate manifestation|
|THE First Hunger - Tor|
|Classification Upon Emergence: THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Memory Status: Complete retention of all experiences|
|Loyalty Assessment: Strong positive connection to your Way|
|THE Living Origin|
|Classification Upon Emergence: THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|Memory Status: Complete retention of all experiences|
|Loyalty Assessment: Strong positive connection to your Way|
At this moment, the cocoons of singularities surrounded by all eighteen Core Phonemes of The First Tongue seethed with unfathomable and infinite potential.
The aura of a terrifying entity began blazing outward from within them with building intensity.
The cocoons trembled and pulsed as the Phonemes glowed brighter and brighter.
Alongside the eruption of these overwhelming auras, a voice suddenly echoed out.
"Oh, what the shit is this now? I was sleeping in endless Hunger so soundly and peacefully..."
The voice was unique and ancient, carrying weight of eons and a casual irreverence that seemed utterly out of place given the circumstances.
The moment it emerged, the figure of Khor began trembling violently.
Her eyes went wide as tears started forming and streaming down her small face.
Her millions of obsidian jaws froze in place as her entire being focused on that voice.
The cocoon surrounded by radiant Weavings of The First Tongue began breaking apart.
Cracks of brilliant light spread across its surface as the singularity within reached critical manifestation.
And from it, the visage of Tor walked out with casual confidence.
He had an ancient and wild appearance that spoke of primordial power barely contained.
His long obsidian hair danced wildly on his head as if each strand possessed independent life.
Shadowy weavings of pure Hunger wrapped around his muscular figure like living tattoos.
His body radiated raw physical power, muscles defined but not bulky, lean and dangerous.
He looked like a primordial beast that had been sleeping for eons and had now returned to Existence with full might.
He blinked slowly as he looked around, taking in his surroundings with curiosity.
His gaze swept across the veiled domain before coming to lock onto Noah specifically.
His jaw opened in shock as recognition flared in his eyes.
"Little Anomaly? What... how are you..."
Before his words could even finish, the diminutive figure of Khor threw herself into his chest with desperate velocity.
She crashed into him and wrapped her arms around him as tightly as she could manage.
Tor looked down at her with expression softening immediately.
He spoke with natural affection as if no time had passed at all.
"Ah, Little Monster. I was going to come take a look at you soon regardless. Relax! I’m here now."
He wrapped his arms around her small form and held her as she sobbed against his chest.
Two embodiments of Hunger embraced as eons of separation finally ended.
At the same time, from the second cocoon filled with white-gold Weavings of Origin, another emergence began.
The structure broke apart with graceful inevitability.
AndTHE Living Originstepped forth with unfathomable majesty that made reality itself seem to pause.
She was unfathomably beautiful in ways that transcended simple physical appearance.
Her white-gold hair flowed like liquid light down past her shoulders.
Her skin was fair and seemed to glow with inner radiance.
Her golden eyes held endless depth, as if one could peer into them and see the origin point of all things.
She wore robes that seemed woven from the concept of beginnings themselves.
Her terrifying power atTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntypulsed outward in waves.
She took a single step forward as her eyes looked around Existence with analytical gaze.
Taking in the veiled domain, the gathered entities, the state of reality.
Before her gaze finally locked onto Noah with focused intensity.
THE Living Origin. THE First Hunger.
Infinite Potentialhad been actualized into concrete reality.
This represented one of the first terrifying actions thatTHE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexiconswas taking.
Beside Noah floatedTHE Living Order,Sigrid, her own power still building towardTHEclassification.
And at this moment, a surreal reality existed within this contained domain of space.
Surrounded by veiled Weavings of The First Tongue.
Three THE Surface Depth entities stood within arm’s reach.
All connected to Noah’s Way.
And uniquely...THE was not suppressed by Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4641: Half My Weight!
paragraphs: In Existence, many believed connections with others weren’t important.
That they could accomplish everything themselves through sheer individual will and power.
That bonds were weaknesses to avoid rather than strengths to cultivate.
While this approach could work in some cases, the truth was simpler: connections ruled Existence at the deepest levels.
Consider Ains, The Fisherman.
He’d formed connections withUl’morethand the other Ginnu Lifeforms across countless eons.
WhenTHE Primordial Chaosarrived to test him with impossible choices, those connections meant Ains chose sacrifice over self-preservation.
He gave a warning. He tried to protect those he’d bonded with across time.
OrUl’morethhimself,THE Primeval Titan.
He’d forged a teaching bond with Noah in Ginnungagap.
When the moment of crisis arrived, whenTHE Primordial Chaosheld Noah’s hand in that terrible grip,Ul’morethburned his very Way of Primordial Continuity to switch places with his student.
The connection between teacher and student proved stronger than survival instinct.
Or examineTHE Creature’sown actions.
He’d allowed Noah to complete his Temporal Traversal not out of mercy, but because of the connections Noah had forged.
Those connections meant Noah’s influence had spread to entities who would be locked inThe Belly of Existence. THE Belly of Existence!
Entities whose enhanced cultivation across eons would benefitTHE Creaturehimself through the connection of imprisonment.
EvenTHE Living Origin’scollapse byTHE Living Paradoxhad come about because of connections.
Her backing ofTHE Creaturehad created chances that Paradox exploited.
Connections shaped outcomes at every level of power.
While you didn’t absolutely need bonds or connections to succeed in Existence, they certainly made the path easier, more stable, and stronger.
Isolation wasn’t strength. It was just isolation.
In the isolated region of collapse where Noah had layered waves of Logos to create a veiled domain, the air hummed with building power.

His existence was being reinforced by waves of boundless harvest andInfinite Potentialstemming from his actions and their cascading consequences, and he stared at another manifestation of that same Potential made flesh.
Tor and THE Living Origin.
Two entities who shouldn’t exist in this era, now standing before him because of the closed temporal loop he’d created.
Tor had his attention taken by Khor, who still clung to him with desperate relief.
Meanwhile,THE Living Originstared straight at Noah with a gaze mixing confusion and deep serenity.
This was an entity who’d been collapsed byTHE Living Paradoxhimself.
One of those who should have enjoyed the Weavings ofThe Belly of Existence, of THE Prison where THE Creaturelocked everything within The Infinite Unfurling.
That alone should have made her incredibly powerful across the eons.
And yetTHE Living Paradoxhad still managed to collapse her even with all the accumulated power thatTHE Creature’sprison had granted her.
That single fact said a lot about the true power and schemes ofTHE Living Paradox.
At this time,THE Living Originfinally made her move.
She looked at Noah with those endless golden eyes and spoke. Eons weighed down every word.

"Existence is filled with mysteries beyond counting. But there are only a select few entities who are truly capable of fighting against and controlling the flow of Existence itself. By doing what you’re doing, by bringing us back from Infinite Potential, by challenging the established order, you’re placing yourself among the ranks of those who seek to hold Existence in their palms."
She paused before continuing with building intensity.

"THE Creature. THE Living Paradox. THE Primordial Chaos. THE Living Temporal. THE Secretive Eon. THE Tongue Whisper. You would be seeking to climb to the ranks of these supreme beings who shape reality itself. Are you that type of being? Are you HIM?"
Was heHIM?
The question carried serious weight in the context of Existence.
To beHIMmeant more than simple power or classification.
It meant having the conviction that you could reshape reality according to your vision.
It meant believing with absolute certainty that your Way was correct and worth any sacrifice.
It meant standing against impossible odds and refusing to yield regardless of consequence.
It meant being the type of entity around which Existence itself would have to bend and reorganize.
Noah thought about the question for a brief moment before responding with calm certainty.
"I am HIM."
HUUM!
He said this with unwavering confidence that allowed no room for doubt or hesitation.
His eyes blazed with absolute conviction as the words emerged.
THE Living Originnodded slowly a moment later, as if his response confirmed something she’d suspected.

"In the past, I listened to another entity tell me the exact same thing with the same conviction. I followed him with complete loyalty. I believed him without reservation. And yet despite all that belief and backing, I was still collapsed by Paradox. Perhaps I should have never followed another’s vision. Perhaps I should have trusted only my own Way. But now, it’s far too late for such regrets. I’ve become cautious now through painful experience."
Her expression became more guarded.

"Even though I understand that every action has a reaction, that causality demands equal exchange, I still have to be careful. I still have to be absolutely certain before committing fully. So for now, as gratitude for bringing my Way and Existence back to bloom in this era, I’ll give half of the Weight of my Way towards your brilliance. Towards your vision and your Way."
She held up one hand as if making a formal declaration.

"If you allow me to observe your actions for a while longer, if you demonstrate that your vision truly differs from what came before, then I’ll decide whether to completely give my full weight and backing to you without reservation."
HUUM!
The words were heavy with implication.
An immense brilliance erupted around Noah as reality responded to her declaration.
Prompts descended before his vision.
|Backing Received -THE Living Origin|
|THE Living Origin has placed half of her backing, half of the Immensity of her Way, in support of your vision|
|Classification: Partial Backing of THE Surface Depth entity|
|Weight Added to Your Existence: Tremendous|
|Effects of Partial Backing:|
|- Your Existential Weight increased quintessentially|
|- Your Civilizational Authority enhanced quintessentially|
|- Your Way of Mana and Hunger resonates with her Way of Origin|
|- All entities in your Civilization receive 120% boost to advancement speed|
|- Your Foundation stability increased by 890%|
|Lineage Integration:|
|THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons has recognized the significance of this backing|
|The meaning and importance of this action is being transformed intoInfinite Potential|
|This Potential flows toward your Foundation and Way of Existence|

chapters.title: Chapter 4642: Crossing A Line
paragraphs: The Prompts continued with an unending momentum!
|Historical Context - WARNING:|
|THE Living Origin previously gave her backing to THE Creature before her collapse|
|The effects of her backing towardTHE Creatureacross eons were substantial|
|It is unknown what cascading effects will bloom now that her backing is directed toward you|
|Even though this backing is currently partial (50%), it may draw attention from interested parties|
|Additional Note:|
|When/IfTHE Living Origingrants full backing (100%), the effects will exceed current parameters by orders of magnitude|
As Noah watched these prompts cascade down before his vision, his eyes maintained their heavy brilliance.
He simply nodded with calm acceptance and spoke with measured certainty.

"My Way is mine, and I’ll move as I see fit according to my own vision. If you agree with my actions and choices, that’s good for both of us. If you don’t agree at some point, that’s also fine. But I do have a lot of questions for you about what happened in The Infinite Unfurling and what you know of THE Creature’s true plans."
As he said all this, off to the side, Tor finally pulled Khor away from his chest.
He held her at arm’s length with both hands, examining her with a critical eye.
The obsidian skin and wild hair of this ancient being danced with shadowy Hunger as he spoke with a booming voice.

"What is all this official diplomatic bullshit?! When you commit to something, Origin, just do it completely! What’s the need for all this righteous posturing of ’ooh, I have to carefully watch you first and cautiously decide, ooh!’ Do it simply! Do it easily and directly!"
He turned his gaze toward Noah.

"The Little Anomaly has allowed my Hunger to bloom once more in this era and protected Little Monster here while I was gone, even though she seems disappointingly weak after all the potential I left her with. When you commit to something, Origin, commit FULLY like you used to! I always told you this back in the old days!"
He raised his voice with passionate intensity.

"Say it simply and clearly like this: I give the FULL weight of my Way towards the Little Anomaly without reservation! I’ll witness what his unique vision of Existence will become! Because the vision that THE Creature and Paradox and Chaos are pushing fucking SUCKS and leads only to collapse and imprisonment!"
HUUM!
THE First Hungersaid such provocative words with complete conviction.
THE Living Origincalmly stared at him. She’d clearly heard such passionate speeches many times before.
AndToronly smiled and laughed with booming sound.
Right after his declaration, an eruption of even grander waves of brilliant blue-gold light bloomed around Noah!

|- Partial Backing (50%) from THE Living Origin|

|The immense concentration of Infinite Potential from multiple sources has reached critical mass|

|The weight and immensity of your existence has crossed the threshold of THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty|
|DESPITE not having officially claimed THE distinction or classification|
|Your Existential Weight at Pre-THE classification can now rival genuine THE Surface Depth entities|
|This is deemed: Paradoxical and Unprecedented|
|Current Status:|
|Immense concentrations ofInfinite Potentialfrom all sources continue flowing|
|Your Way is being refined continuously|
|Your Foundation is being reinforced beyond theoretical limits|

BOOM!
Noah felt the transformation happening within his existence at the most fundamental level.
The sensation was hard to describe, yet he tried to understand what was happening.
It felt like crossing an invisible threshold into an entirely new way of seeing.
His vision began slowly changing as the weight ofTHE Surface Depthsettled into his being.
He started seeing everything differently.
Not as solid objects or separate entities, but as waves and strings vibrating with their own unique frequencies.
Each entity, each piece of matter, each expression of authority appeared as complex patterns of vibration.
These countless individual vibrations came together, harmonizing and interfacing, to form what made up Existence itself.
He could perceive... the fundamental frequency of Mana underlying everything.
He could sense the linguistic resonance of The First Tongue structuring reality.
He could observe how different Ways created different vibrational patterns that either harmonized or clashed with each other.
It was as if a veil had been lifted from his perception, allowing him to see the true machinery of reality operating beneath the surface appearance.
This was what it meant to approach THE.
To perceive Existence not as it appeared, but as it fundamentally was.
And he’d achieved this perception without even officially grasping THE classification yet.
What would happen when he actually crossed that final threshold?

chapters.title: Chapter 4643: And Then There Was You I
paragraphs: As Noah acclimated to the new sense of power coursing through him,Tor and THE Living Originseemed to sense the shift.
The former continued with casual interest as he spoke.

"You and others like you always like to do things with flair and fashion. You haven’t truly grasped any Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, and yet the immensity of your existence seems to have reached it anyway. I used to take you to fight weak little things that had just laid a claim on their Sovereignty, but do you think you could fight against me now, Little Anomaly?"
Torasked such a question in a completely carefree manner.
Noah looked back at this entity that had given him his backing and nodded calmly.
"That is among the many things that we can do. And there’s a lot to be done."
Torblinked at this reply.
He looked around at Noah and all the others gathered in this veiled space.
In the next moment, his expression shifted to confusion.
"Why all the sense of doom and gloom here? What’s happening right now?"
What was happening right now?
Noah took this question in calmly as he answered.

"THE Living Paradox and others formed THE Loom, a shelter and weapon, that’s going to collapse all external Existence and Civilization in what they call The Fallout at some indeterminate time. It could be hours or days or weeks or years from now. Survival against The Fallout was a serious question a few days ago, but now... I have a level of confidence towards it. I just need to make sure that all my preparations are ready."
BOOM!
He said such words with calm certainty.
THE First Hungerlooked at him with mounting incredulity before gazing at Khor as if he wanted her to confirm this insanity.
Khor nodded with a cloudy face and seemed about to say something else when, at this moment,THE Living Origincalmly inserted herself into the conversation.

"Well... THE Loom is actually a Key. A key that THE Living Paradox designed to unlock THE Belly of Existence, the prison under the warden of...THE Creature that holds countless entities from The Infinite Unfurling. Its full scope of action will be unknown. But its eruption would mean that THE Living Paradox is ready to begin his fight against THE Creature with this weapon, to tear across The Belly of Existence to do whatever it was designed to do. And likely all of those imprisoned in The Infinite Unfurling will also be released."
BOOM!
She paused before continuing with heavy words.
"But it was made with my Heart of Origin and Weavings of others that supported THE Creature. And of course... the Heart of Hunger."
BOOM!
Terrifying words were uttered from her mouth.
Noah looked at her closely before he spoke.
"Alright, this is why we need to have a proper talk. Let’s- "
Before Noah’s words could finish,THE First Hungerinterjected.
His expression turned cloudy as obsidian crimson light began dancing around his frame.
The shadows of Hunger writhing across his skin intensified into something more volatile.
His voice came out flat and dangerous.
"What do you mean the Heart of Hunger was utilized in its forging?"
Silence came.
When this entity asked this question, Noah reserved answering it himself.
He turned his attention towards the one thatTHE First Hungercalled Little Monster.
Khor.
At this time, this diminutive figure of the ancient entity looked towards Tor with a cold gaze.
As if she was laying out her grievances to an older member of her family.
As if she’d been waiting eons to say these words.

"THE Living Paradoxcollapsed my Way and Civilization as he used my Heart of Hunger, my Primacy of Hunger, to fuse and mutate all the countless Inevitabilities into the walls of his Loom. For the past eons, Inevitabilities have been forced to hunger and hungerendlessly, never keeping any of the authority that they take in as it all goes towards supportingTHE Loom. Every single Inevitability without question was mutated and forced to experience this endless sense of unsatisfied hunger."
Her voice was steady but cold as ice.

"My emergence was made possible by the Outsider here, and the current Inevitabilities that you see around us are the product of what we’ve managed to achieve as we forge a new Civilization of Hunger from the ruins."
Her words got to the core of the issue.
The body ofTHE First Hungertrembled.
An unfathomably dangerous aura radiated from him as it looked like he would explode at any moment.
The air itself seemed to warp around him as crimson shadows pulsed outward.
But then, moments later, he reached out towards Khor again and held her.
He stroked the hair on her head with surprising gentleness despite the rage building in his frame.
His eyes had turned pure crimson when he turned to look at Noah.
The carefree demeanor from just moments ago was completely gone.
In its place was immense coldness and barely contained fury.

"You said you needed to prepare. What needs to be done so that sometime in the future, I can look at the face of THE Living Paradox and peel the skin from his existence? Slowly. Piece by piece. Until there’s nothing left but his screaming Weavings."
A sense of wildness and contained rage pulsed withinTHE First Hungeras he asked such a thing.
Even though they all knew how impossibly hard it would be to accomplish.
Even thoughTHE Living Paradoxwas one of the supreme beings who controlled the flow of Existence itself.
Even though he’d collapsed both Origin and Hunger in the past and walked away unscathed.
But Noah nodded lightly.
He looked towardsTHE Living Originas he spoke.

"The first thing we need to do is get a good grasp of exactly what’s happening around us. Information. Knowledge. We need to understand the full scope of what we’re facing and what resources we actually have."
He turned his gaze fully to her.
"Are you able to help us with this, Origin?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4644: And Then There Was You II
paragraphs: Noah wantedTHE Living Originto provide whatever knowledge she had.
He continued to come across the reality that you could do a whole lot more when you had the correct type of required knowledge.
Consider what he’d learned fromUl’morethabout Mana and The First Tongue.
That knowledge had allowed him to answer The Oldest Paradox of Existence and trigger his Lineage emergence.
Those eighteen Core Phonemes had become the foundation of his power and allowed him to accomplish feats that shouldn’t be possible at his classification.
Knowledge was power in the most literal sense, and he needed more of it.
So at this time, he and many others were looking at the famous figure ofTHE Living Origin.
Noah felt the hands of Sigrid grasping onto his as she looked towardsTHE Living Origin.
Her eyes shined brilliantly as if she was observing a living legend.
After all, even though at this moment Sigrid wasTHE Living Order, she was the one who’d been born in the Transcendent Origin Folds as a Living Origin.
She revered the stories and legends ofTHE Living Originherself.
The sense of slight nervousness and anticipation in Sigrid’s eyes as she looked atTHE Living Originallowed Noah to ease somewhat from his serious state of mind.
It reminded him that even in the case of an apocalypse, he didn’t need to be so high-strung and serious.
He wasHIM, right?
He moved with glorious quintessence and tyranny as he currently held a sense of confidence when it came to The Fallout.
So he would simply move accordingly and continue to live Existence as he wished to. As he normally would.
Because even as all of this was happening, he needed to make up for the lost time with many in The Infiniverse.
And of course, ensure that there would be more time with them after The Fallout.
But for now, he needed to continue getting back to his baseline Weavings of Existence.
The events of the Temporal Traversal were truly too heavy as he was still acclimating from them.
As he thought about this, the figure ofTHE Living Originrose up.
Many eyes focused on her as she waved her hands to manifest an illusory white-gold diagram.
It depicted an 8-cube octeracthypercubewith intricate geometric patterns.
She began to speak with measured clarity.

"In The Infinite Unfurling, THE Creature had grand designs and ideals. He could see Existence was continuing to unfold with boundless Chaos, with no structure. At least this was what he told us. He wanted to form a structure, and one of the major issues was that there were too many damn THE entities. Each one sought to find and establish their Way of Existence. Each one essentially fighting for supremacy. It caused a tumultuous Existence with constant battles and conflict, not to mention the conflicts of The Oldest Paradox of Existence that included THE Creature and others."
She paused before continuing.

"And so he gathered some of us. Those who he knew and those he didn’t. Apart from THE Creature, we took on the distinctions of THE Living Existences. THE Living Origin, THE Living Concept, THE Living Dimensional, THE Living Order... we all held grand ideals. And to be on the same page, we all held the distinction of Living apart from THE Creature. The solution that we eventually implemented was THE Prison. THE Unfurling Nodes of Existence. THE Belly of Existence that would contain all the countless entities seeking supremacy in their Civilizations... to usher in an extended period of Order where a select few would focus on their Civilizations and actually have a chance of ascending the scales of Existence."
The words fromTHE Living Originwere heavy.
Noah and the others listened with shining eyes.
And as ifTHE Living Origincould see into the brilliance of Noah’s eyes and what he was thinking, she continued right after.

"Yes, how arrogant it was for us to think that way. What hubris we had to believe ourselves to be grander and that we had more right than others to elevate our Civilizations while imprisoning everyone else. But THE Creature was a convincing being. THE Creature was an undeniable being. Many of us convinced ourselves that those who would be contained in this prison wouldn’t be harmed as they would continue to follow their Ways of Existence in a contained space, and we would simply benefit from their advancements. So The Belly of Existence was formed. And all of Observable Existence became quieter. There were only a few glorious Civilizations moving across Existence..."
As she said all of this, she turned to look towardsTHE First Hunger.
He had a cloudy expression while gazing at her.
She continued with a softer tone.

"Because of me and Hunger coming together in The Infinite Unfurling due to your existence, I grew a soft spot for the buffoon there. I sought permission from THE Creature to exclude him from the imprisonment. Thus, Hunger was free. I just didn’t expect all that followed. The golden age of cultivation and elevation of Civilizations that we were all envisioning did start. We did make tremendous advancements as we benefited from The Belly of Existence. THE Creature ushered in an entire new lineage under his name... Early Creatures. There was a propagation of Hunger as Inevitabilities multiplied, and Living Existences bloomed in our image as we forged our Civilizations."
Her expression became darker.
"But of course, inevitably, something happened. Everything began to break down the moment that THE Living Paradox collapsed THE Living Order."
THE Living Originlooked like she was about to continue when at this time, Noah spoke up.
"Hold on, hold on."
He felt like he was missing some critical piece of information there.
He wanted to backtrack a little bit.
"What of THE Primordial Chaos, THE Secretive Eon... were these entities that are seemingly on the same caliber as THE Creature also locked in The Belly of Existence?"
It was a question that deserved an answer.
And at this time,THE Living Originlooked towards him and said simply.
"I don’t know."
What?
"What do you mean you don’t know?" Noah couldn’t help but ask.
Once more,THE Living Originshook her head and replied calmly.
"I don’t know."
Noah’s eyes became even sharper.
He turned his gaze up and looked around the veiled space as his mind worked through the implications.

Does this mean that monstrous entities on the same level asTHE Creaturecould actually be outside of the prison? Suppressed somewhere in Existence or hiding in the gaps of reality? Or were they still contained within The Belly of Existence but... they were strong enough thatTHE Creaturecouldn’t siphon off any of their power?

Because even as all of this was happening, he needed to make up for the lost time with many in The Infiniverse.
And of course, ensure that there would be more time with them after The Fallout.
But for now, he needed to continue getting back to his baseline Weavings of Existence.
The events of the Temporal Traversal were truly too heavy as he was still acclimating from them.
As he thought about this, the figure ofTHE Living Originrose up.
Many eyes focused on her as she waved her hands to manifest an illusory white-gold diagram.
It depicted an 8-cube octeracthypercubewith intricate geometric patterns.
She began to speak with measured clarity.
"In The Infinite Unfurling, THE Creature had grand designs and ideals.
He could see Existence was continuing to unfold with boundless Chaos, with no structure.
At least this was what he told us.
He wanted to form a structure, and one of the major issues was that there were too many damn THE entities.
Each one sought to find and establish their Way of Existence.
Each one essentially fighting for supremacy.
It caused a tumultuous Existence with constant battles and conflict, not to mention the conflicts of The Oldest Paradox of Existence that included THE Creature and others."
She paused before continuing.
"And so he gathered some of us.
Those who he knew and those he didn’t.
Apart from THE Creature, we took on the distinctions of THE Living Existences.
THE Living Origin, THE Living Concept, THE Living Dimensional, THE Living Order... we all held grand ideals.
And to be on the same page, we all held the distinction of Living apart from THE Creature.
The solution that we eventually implemented was THE Prison.
THE Unfurling Nodes of Existence.

THE Belly of Existence that would contain all the countless entities seeking supremacy in their Civilizations... to usher in an extended period of Order where a select few would focus on their Civilizations and actually have a chance of ascending the scales of Existence."
The words fromTHE Living Originwere heavy.
Noah and the others listened with shining eyes.
And as ifTHE Living Origincould see into the brilliance of Noah’s eyes and what he was thinking, she continued right after.
"Yes, how arrogant it was for us to think that way.
What hubris we had to believe ourselves to be grander and that we had more right than others to elevate our Civilizations while imprisoning everyone else.
But THE Creature was a convincing being.
THE Creature was an undeniable being.

Many of us convinced ourselves that those who would be contained in this prison wouldn’t be harmed as they would continue to follow their Ways of Existence in a contained space, and we would simply benefit from their advancements.
So The Belly of Existence was formed.
And all of Observable Existence became quieter.
There were only a few glorious Civilizations moving across Existence..."
As she said all of this, she turned to look towardsTHE First Hunger.
He had a cloudy expression while gazing at her.
She continued with a softer tone.
"Because of me and Hunger coming together in The Infinite Unfurling due to your existence, I grew a soft spot for the buffoon there.
I sought permission from THE Creature to exclude him from the imprisonment.
Thus, Hunger was free.
I just didn’t expect all that followed.
The golden age of cultivation and elevation of Civilizations that we were all envisioning did start.
We did make tremendous advancements as we benefited from The Belly of Existence.
THE Creature ushered in an entire new lineage under his name...
Early Creatures.
There was a propagation of Hunger as Inevitabilities multiplied, and Living Existences bloomed in our image as we forged our Civilizations."
Her expression became darker.
"But of course, inevitably, something happened.
Everything began to break down the moment that THE Living Paradox collapsed THE Living Order."
THE Living Originlooked like she was about to continue when at this time, Noah spoke up.
"Hold on, hold on."
He felt like he was missing some critical piece of information there.
He wanted to backtrack a little bit.
"What of THE Primordial Chaos, THE Secretive Eon... were these entities that are seemingly on the same caliber as THE Creature also locked in The Belly of Existence?"
It was a question that deserved an answer.
And at this time,THE Living Originlooked towards him and said simply.
"I don’t know."
What?
"What do you mean you don’t know?" Noah couldn’t help but ask.
Once more,THE Living Originshook her head and replied calmly.
"I don’t know."
Noah’s eyes became even sharper.
He turned his gaze up and looked around the veiled space as his mind worked through the implications.
Does this mean that monstrous entities on the same level asTHE Creaturecould actually be outside of the prison?
Suppressed somewhere in Existence or hiding in the gaps of reality?
Or were they still contained within The Belly of Existence but... they were strong enough thatTHE Creaturecouldn’t siphon off any of their power?

chapters.title: Chapter 4645: And Then There Was You III
paragraphs: There were far too many unknowns.
At this time, Noah shook his head as he motioned forTHE Living Originto continue.
She nodded simply as she spoke.

"I don’t know what triggered it. I don’t know why Paradox rebelled. Maybe being at the same stature as THE Creature and enjoying part of the boons of The Belly of Existence was a trigger. Maybe due to their nature, this was always bound to happen. But regardless, conflict began to bloom. Civilizations were collapsed, and in secret THE Loom was forged. Emotive, that fucking bitch..."
Woah woah woah.
Noah had to almost stopTHE Living Originfrom destroying her image there as she revealed some emotion.
She had Sigrid and others that were big fans of hers, and seeing the veil of majesty and power crack slightly as she expressed her emotions here was unique!
THE Living Originseemingly calmed herself before she continued with more measured tones.

"A lot happened, but the gist of it... I was collapsed, and THE Living Law was collapsed... some survived, some joined THE Living Paradox and Emotive... I don’t know the full history as many of them moved in secret. But in the end, it seems that THE Living Paradox somehow succeeded in going against THE Creature as his preparations are nearly finished. All of these eons should just be the preparations of THE Living Paradox as he needs to face off against THE Creature. Because THE Creature is terrifying and THE Creature is not something that anyone can overcome."
She paused with heavy emphasis.

"And yet, paradoxically, THE Living Paradox lives up to his name. To overcome THE Creature. After all, they are all part of The Oldest Paradox of Existence. Of what came first. And Paradox is right there in the name. The rest of us were bound to be mere casualties in all of this. But now there is you. Or... there was you."
BOOM!
THE Living Originlooked towards Noah as if she was also trying to understand him.
As if he held his own oddities that couldn’t fully be explained!
Her golden eyes studied him with intense focus.

"Because you appeared in the past, and you are here in the future. You are also a part of The Oldest Paradox of Existence. You were there... before The Belly of Existence which locked everyone away was made. You were also there before THE Loom was formed. You... are like The Others in this regard. Anomalies."
She said such ridiculous words.
In the next moment, many eyes turned towards Noah.
Khor, Sigrid, Moiraine, Henry, and many others adorned in Civilizational Armors in the ranks of Primus Inevitabilities all looked towards him with shining eyes.
As if he was some legendary figure.
Noah shook his head.
THE Living Originwas making him seem like some crazy big bad or scary entity when she said things like this.
He couldn’t even begin to explain the capability that allowed him to go back so far in time.
And the idea of closed temporal loops that even he had to read over a few times just to tell himself that he fully understood it.
He was just someone with a little bit of Mana.
If he was left alone and didn’t have to worry about the collapse of Existence ruining his life, he would be perfectly content to be a farmer in a remote region ofObservable Existence.
He would be more than happy to tend to an Early Veiled Shore, plant Sacred Herbs, delve into unique Depths, and enjoy the company of his family.
But no.
THE Primordial Chaoshad to do what he did.
THE Living Paradoxhad to do what he was doing.
AndTHE Creaturehad to do what he was doing.
So at this moment, Noah had to also do what he was doing.
Until a future came where he could look upon the endlessObservable Existenceand not have to worry about what could happen in the next moment.
Until he could actually live the quiet life he’d prefer.
So at this time, he nodded towards the figure ofTHE Living Originbefore she could say anything else too crazy to make him seem grander than he was.
"Okay. There may be a few smaller details here and there that I’ll ask you about, but for now let’s prepare. Let’s go to my own little Belly of Existence. My own Loom."
He said such words casually.
He began to emanate waves of Logos in the surrounding region, sensing his connection to The Infiniverse as he started forming a doorway.
Blue-gold light carved through space itself as The First Tongue structured reality according to his will.
The Phonemes of Space, Beginning, and Division wove together to create a passage.
There was much to be done, especially withTHE Living Paradoxstating that Existence was five seconds to Midnight.
He had Core Phonemes to design and complete.
A box from Ul’moreth to open that contained something important.
The Infiniverse needed continued development.
Sigrid required support as she approachedTHE Surface Depth.
Tor and THE Living Originneeded to be integrated into his Civilization properly.
The prisoners inTHE Infinite Desmoterionneeded evaluation.
His family and allies deserved time and attention after all that had happened.
And beyond all of that, he needed to forge a response to The Fallout that would ensure survival and perhaps even victory.
A lot more. So much more!
The doorway completed itself with a pulse of blue-gold radiance.
On the other side, many things awaited.
His Civilization. His people. His foundation for whatever came next.
Noah stepped forward as Sigrid’s hand remained clasped in his.
Torfollowed with Khor still held protectively.
THE Living Originmoved with measured grace.
And one by one, the others began to file through.
Entering the domain that Noah had built, entering the space where preparations would be made...entering the future that he was forging with his own hands!
In Existence, many believed that fate was inescapable.
That the paths laid out by those with greater power couldn’t be deviated from.
That entities like THE Creature, THE Living Paradox, and THE Primordial Chaos moved pieces on a board where others had no agency.
This belief was comforting in a way.
If you had no choice, then you bore no responsibility for the outcome.
If the game was rigged from the start, then you couldn’t be blamed for losing.
But the truth was more complex and far more terrifying.
Fate existed, yes.But only as grand designs that were laid by supreme beings across eons.
Yet within those designs, choices remained.
Ains chose to save his friends even knowing it would cost him everything.
Ul’morethchose to burn his Way to save a student he’d known for mere hours.
THE Living Originchose to exclude Tor from imprisonment because of a soft spot.
THE Living Paradoxchose rebellion against the established order.
And Noah chose to keep moving forward rather than accept the roles others tried to assign him.
Anomaly. Casualty. Pawn in games between existential entities.
These were labels others placed on him, but labels only had the power you gave them.
Every being in Existence, from the weakest toTHEentities themselves, possessed the fundamental capability to choose.
To act according to their own vision rather than accept the vision imposed by others.
The question was never whether choice existed, the question was always whether you had the courage to make it.
Whether you had the strength to bear the consequences.
Whether you had the will to keep choosing even when every choice led to more complexity, more danger, more responsibility.
Noah had made his choice.
Not to be a farmer tending Sacred Herbs in peaceful obscurity. Not to accept the role of casualty in conflicts between supreme beings. Not to wait passively for The Fallout to determine his fate.
He chose to be HIM.
To forge his own path using The First Tongue and Mana, and some ridiculous cheats here and there to build something that could stand against The Fallout.
To protect those he cared about regardless of what entities atTHE Surface Depthor beyond decided.
Was this arrogance? Perhaps.
Was this hubris? Possibly. Quintessentially! Majisterially!
Was this the only choice he could live with? Abso-fucking-lutely.

In Existence, fate was real. But so was choice. And the interplay between the two was where legends were born! The interplay between the two was where THE Genesis Monarch could move with interminable glory.

chapters.title: Chapter 4646: THE Farewell of Ginnungagap I
paragraphs: Noah delved into The Infiniverse while thinking of the many things that had to be accomplished.
The idea of The Fallout was something he could look at in different ways.
If he looked at it like a blade hanging over his neck that could fall at any moment, he might never get anything done.
Others might feel a sense of pressure to the extent that things would feel suffocating.
But he put it in the back of his mind as he got ready to do the countless things that needed to be done.
Because why worry when he had no control of when Midnight came?
So for now...
HUUM!
His body flickered and divided into multiple bodies, each one disappearing into different domains.
One pulled back to the region of collapse with the imprisoned Schrodinger and The Disciple ofTHE Creatureand others.
Others went elsewhere.
Moments later, he appeared with everyone in The Early Veiled Shore that was now unfathomably vast!
The brows ofTHE Living Originrose as she looked at Noah up and down while staring at The Early Veiled Shore before she spoke.
"Are you sure you aren’t THE Creature?"
Noah didn’t even glance at her as he moved forward while speaking.

"I’m sure I’m not THE Creature. Welcome to my Osmontian Shore. The bastion that will eventually stand against THE Loom. Settle in for now and acclimate. There are Sacred Herbs and Sacred Mead for everyone to enjoy. I have a few things to look at first. Malphas, can you take care of everyone?"
The moment he finished speaking, the butler-like figure of Malphas appeared and bowed as he took over care of the new entrants!
Sigridalso sent a message that she would momentarily keepTHE Living Origincompany.
Noah nodded at this as he turned his gaze towards the visage of Elyndra and The First Farmer, who was currently gazing around with shining eyes!
The entity who planted Seeds of Principles.
He wanted to see what would happen if he actually had knowledge that he was playing with The First Tongue without knowing it.
Noah approached Elyndra and The First Farmer, who both turned their gazes towards him with shining eyes.
He put his hand around Elyndra’s waist and gave her a kiss on her forehead as he spoke softly.
"Let me borrow your father for a second."
Elyndra smiled shyly while nodding with her head down.
The First Farmer had his mouth twitching as light wrapped around him and Noah.
And the two of them disappeared.
They reappeared far from The Early Veiled Shore, inside a budding Transcendent Helios Fold filled with crimson-gold plasma and lemniscate singularities.
Energy pulsed around them in rhythmic patterns.
In this space, The First Farmer scrubbed the image of Elyndra and Noah from his consciousness as he calmly spoke.
"It seems much has changed since we last talked. I didn’t know you were a farmer as well."
Noah nodded lightly as he looked at this being while raising his hand.
He formed a concentrated bundle of knowledge regarding The First Tongue and the eighteen Core Phonemes.
Blue-gold light coalesced into a perfect sphere of information.

"Causality is a unique thing. In the past, you forged the Seed of The Principle of Perpetual Harvest and failed. I completed that Seed for you. And now, I will expand your knowledge as I infuse you with understanding of The First Tongue that makes up all Principles. All the workings of Existence. The equations that explain how Existence flows the way it does. The fundamental linguistic structure underlying reality itself."
As he said this, The First Farmer’s eyes opened wide in shock.
But Noah moved swiftly to throw the singularity of knowledge forward.
It flowed into The First Farmer’s existence!
The eyes of The First Farmer trembled with shock, then recognition, then pure ecstasy.
His entire body began to glow with building radiance.
His breathing became rapid as eons of effort and failure suddenly made sense.
BOOM!
From his body, a Phoneme of Fire began to be constructed!
Brilliant green-gold flames erupted around him as linguistic structures manifested in the air.
The ancient patterns of The First Tongue bloomed from his Weavings.
Prompts descended before Noah’s vision.
|Anomalous Factor of Existence Detected|
|Entity: The First Farmer|
|Anomalous Factor Classification: THE SEED|
|Definition - Anomalous Factor of Existence:|
|Unique configurations within an entity’s Weavings that grant exceptional potential beyond normal parameters of Existence|
|These factors remain dormant until specific conditions trigger their awakening|
|Once awakened, they provide exponential advancement in specialized domains|
|The First Farmer’s Anomalous Factor - THE SEED:Innate capability to perceive, nurture, and cultivate abstract concepts as if they were living organisms|
|This factor has remained partially dormant for eons|
|The First Farmer has unknowingly been manipulating Logos of The First Tongue through his factor|
|Without understanding the linguistic foundation, his success rate was minimal|
|Condition Met: Exposure to complete knowledge of the 18 Core Phonemes|
|AWAKENING SEQUENCE - COMPLETE|
|The Weavings of The First Farmer bloom after eons of failure and effort|
|After associating with Weavings of The First Tongue for countless ages without recognizing it|
|After failing and succeeding in nurturing abstract Logos of Principles|
|All this accumulated potential has now been culminated and unleashed|
|Harvest Assessment:|
|A Harvest of significant Infinite Potential has been collected from The First Farmer due to the effect of your actions|
|This Potential flows toward your Foundation and Core Phoneme development|
Noah watched the scene before him with shining eyes as he thought about the information regarding Anomalous Factor of Existence.
Would him awakening to Infinite Mana all those years ago be considered his Anomalous Factor?
Or could he not even put himself on the same scale as others?
He couldn’t say for sure.
But at this time, he sat down while watching the dazed First Farmer erupt with ridiculous talent to design his first Phoneme.
The ancient entity’s body blazed with green-gold flames as linguistic structures formed and reformed around him.
And while The First Farmer did this, this body of Noah here would have a simple job.
"Focus the Infinite Potential on getting my own personalized Phonemes completed and finalize the analysis of which connected Logos make up my Principles so we can take them to Genesis level."
BOOM!
|Understood, Master.|
The reply from Ruination came swiftly as his body began to explode with power.
At the same time, his chest began to shine as he pulled outTHE Farewell of Ginnungagap!
The glorious obsidian-gold box materialized in his hands.
It was filled with unfathomable Weavings of ancientness and majesty.
Complex patterns covered every surface, pulsing with preserved power.
The craftsmanship alone spoke of mastery that transcended normal understanding.
Noah looked at it with shining eyes.
The farewell gift from his teacher.
He sighed as he moved to open it, wondering just what might be packed within.
What would Ul’moreth, THE Primeval Titan, consider important enough to give as a final gift?

|Entity: The First Farmer|
|Anomalous Factor Classification: THE SEED|
|Definition - Anomalous Factor of Existence:|
|Unique configurations within an entity’s Weavings that grant exceptional potential beyond normal parameters of Existence|
|These factors remain dormant until specific conditions trigger their awakening|
|Once awakened, they provide exponential advancement in specialized domains|
|The First Farmer’s Anomalous Factor - THE SEED:Innate capability to perceive, nurture, and cultivate abstract concepts as if they were living organisms|
|This factor has remained partially dormant for eons|
|The First Farmer has unknowingly been manipulating Logos of The First Tongue through his factor|
|Without understanding the linguistic foundation, his success rate was minimal|
|Condition Met: Exposure to complete knowledge of the 18 Core Phonemes|
|AWAKENING SEQUENCE - COMPLETE|
|The Weavings of The First Farmer bloom after eons of failure and effort|
|After associating with Weavings of The First Tongue for countless ages without recognizing it|
|After failing and succeeding in nurturing abstract Logos of Principles|
|All this accumulated potential has now been culminated and unleashed|
|Harvest Assessment:|
|A Harvest of significant Infinite Potential has been collected from The First Farmer due to the effect of your actions|
|This Potential flows toward your Foundation and Core Phoneme development|
Noah watched the scene before him with shining eyes as he thought about the information regarding Anomalous Factor of Existence.
Would him awakening to Infinite Mana all those years ago be considered his Anomalous Factor?
Or could he not even put himself on the same scale as others?
He couldn’t say for sure.
But at this time, he sat down while watching the dazed First Farmer erupt with ridiculous talent to design his first Phoneme.
The ancient entity’s body blazed with green-gold flames as linguistic structures formed and reformed around him.
And while The First Farmer did this, this body of Noah here would have a simple job.
"Focus the Infinite Potential on getting my own personalized Phonemes completed and finalize the analysis of which connected Logos make up my Principles so we can take them to Genesis level."
BOOM!
|Understood, Master.|
The reply from Ruination came swiftly as his body began to explode with power.
At the same time, his chest began to shine as he pulled outTHE Farewell of Ginnungagap!
The glorious obsidian-gold box materialized in his hands.
It was filled with unfathomable Weavings of ancientness and majesty.
Complex patterns covered every surface, pulsing with preserved power.
The craftsmanship alone spoke of mastery that transcended normal understanding.
Noah looked at it with shining eyes.
The farewell gift from his teacher.
He sighed as he moved to open it, wondering just what might be packed within.
What would Ul’moreth, THE Primeval Titan, consider important enough to give as a final gift?

chapters.title: Chapter 4647: THE Farewell of Ginnungagap II
paragraphs: Who didn’t love opening gifts?

Ever since entering dungeons on the Blue Planet and opening treasure chests, obtaining the Concept of Loot and gaining access to Loot Crates, Loot Caches, and other wondrous forms of treasure, Noah felt giddy whenever opening any box of rewards.
The anticipation of what might be inside never got old.
The possibility of something extraordinary always made his heart race just a little faster.
And this particular gift was uniquely special as it stemmed fromTHE Primeval Titan, Ul’morethhimself!
The one who’d taught him The First Tongue.
The one who’d sacrificed his Way of Primordial Continuity to save Noah fromTHE Primordial Chaos’grasp.
Obsidian-gold light shone from the top of this chest as Noah placed his Primus Mana into it.
And shockingly, the box began to react with building radiance.
The light intensified as complex Weavings activated across its surface.
Gradually, an illusory obsidian-gold image began to emerge.
The form solidified into the towering figure ofTHE Primeval Titan himself, Ul’moreth!
WAA!
Eight hundred meters tall even in this manifestation, his body constructed from living hairy stone and pulsing with ancient power.
His eyes glowed with the same warm intensity Noah remembered.
Noah looked at him with shining eyes as this manifestation looked back and smiled sadly.
The expression held both pride and regret.
|I wish I could have given you the rest of the lessons in person, but... circumstances must have proven to be impossible, so here we are.|
The manifestation’s voice resonated in The First Tongue directly, each word a pulse of structured Mana.

|I talked with you a great deal about Phonemes and a bit about Logos during our brief time together, but I didn’t really get a chance to delve into Philology. I taught you the letters and the words of The First Tongue, but I didn’t teach you the sentences. I didn’t teach you the grammar that allows those sentences to reshape Existence itself.|
Ul’moreth’smanifestation raised one massive hand as blue-gold light began gathering around it.

|Let me explain what Philology truly is. You’ve learned the eighteen Core Phonemes. You’ve formed Logos by combining those Phonemes with intent. But Philology... Philology is the deepest grammatical structure that governs how Logos themselves form.|
The manifestation began pacing as if this were still a classroom lesson.

|Think of it this way. Phonemes are individual letters. Logos are words formed from those letters. But Philology...Philology is the syntax. The underlying rules that determine what is possible within The First Tongue. Not individual words, but the fundamental structure that allows words to exist and have meaning.|
Noah listened with absolute focus as his teacher continued.

|I won’t ramble on too much but...when you form a Logos, you combine Phonemes in a specific order with specific intent. But the order matters tremendously. The same Phonemes arranged differently create entirely different effects. This is syntax. The relationship between the Phonemes determines the ultimate meaning.|
Ul’morethmanifested several Phonemes in the air.
Fire, Water, and Beginning floated before Noah’s vision.
|Watch closely. If I arrange these as: Beginning, Fire, Water...|
The Phonemes aligned and pulsed with specific rhythm.
A small flame appeared that gradually transformed into steam.
|The meaning is: ’What begins as fire becomes water.’ A transformation from one state to another.|
Then the Phonemes rearranged themselves.
|But if I arrange them as: Fire, Beginning, Water...|
The same Phonemes now pulsed with different rhythm.
Steam appeared first, then condensed into water, which erupted into flame.
|Now the meaning is: ’Fire initiates water’s beginning.’ The causal relationship has completely reversed. Same components, entirely different effect. This is the power of syntax.|
Noah’s eyes widened as he absorbed the lesson.

|Logos can also be conjugated to change their properties. You can modify tense to make effects occur in past, present, or future. You can adjust intensity to make them weak or devastatingly strong. You can alter scope to make them affect a single target or the entire scope of Existence.|
BOOM!

The manifestation demonstrated by taking a simple Logos of Fire and showing how subtle variations in the pulse patterns changed it from a small flame to an inferno, from a current blaze to a future ignition, from a localized effect to an existential one.

|And just as words combine into sentences, Logos can combine into compound structures. Multiple Logos woven together create complex ’sentences’ that achieve sophisticated effects impossible with single words alone.|
Ul’moreth’s expression became more serious.

|What you need to understand is that each Sovereignty you’ve encountered - Storm, Hunger, Order, Chaos - these are essentially dialects of The First Tongue. Specialized vocabularies optimized for specific expressions but inherently limited in versatility. You...someone like you and what you stand for as master of The First Tongue...can speak all dialects fluently and even create new ones.|
He paused before continuing.

|Ginnu Lifeforms like myself instinctively know The First Tongue because we emerged when it was being formed. We’re native speakers. Others must consciously learn it like a foreign language. But you, Noah... you can surpass all of us. You could reach the same heights as...them.|
The manifestation’s eyes glowed brighter.

|The progression path is straightforward. First, you must recognize that Mana is language, not just energy. You’ve already accomplished this. Second, you learn Phonemes by understanding individual Mana pulses as distinct units. You’ve mastered all eighteen Core Phonemes. Third, you form simple Logos by combining Phonemes with intent. You’ve been doing this.|
Ul’moreth raised four massive fingers.

|Fourth, you master Logos structure to achieve what we call Singularity Principles. These are refined expressions that embody complete concepts. Fifth, you comprehend Philology to fully access Genesis Principles. This is what I’m teaching you now. And finally, sixth, you learn to speak in complete sentences to reshape Existence at its most fundamental levels.|
The manifestation gestured grandly.

|Genesis Principles are different from Singularity Principles. A Singularity Principle is a perfected expression of a single concept. But a Genesis Principle... a Genesis Principle is the underlying structure that allows entire categories of concepts to exist. It’s the difference between understanding fire and understanding the nature of transformation itself.|
Noah felt his mind expanding as he processed this information.
|I will now teach you the Philology of my three Genesis Principles. I will pass down what I hold to you. Watch carefully and listen with your entire existence, not just your ears.|
The manifestation ofUl’morethraised both hands asTHE Civilizational Authority of Primordial Continuityblazed around him.
He began writing in the air with blue-gold light.
Complex Logos formed, far more intricate than anything Noah had seen before!
Oh!
