chapters.title: Chapter 4648: THE Farewell of Ginnungagap III
paragraphs: Multiple Phonemes woven together in elaborate syntax with conjugations and modifications layered throughout.
The complexity was staggering.
|The first Genesis Principle is: Undifferentiated Mana. This is Mana before it specialized into any particular form. The primordial potential that precedes all actualization.|
The LogosUl’morethwrote was unlike anything Noah had seen before.
It wasn’t just a few Phonemes arranged together.
It was a complete Philology - a full grammatical structure containing multiple Logos woven into a coherent sentence.
The Phoneme of Beginning pulsed first, establishing initiation.
Then Void bloomed to represent the emptiness before differentiation.
Unity threaded through to show wholeness before separation.
Paradox wove in to express the contradiction of being everything and nothing simultaneously.
But the structure didn’t stop there.
Chaos entered the syntax to represent the undirected state before Order imposed form.
Life and Death intertwined to show the potential for both creation and dissolution existing equally.
Fire, Water, Earth, and Air all manifested together - the classical elements in perfect equilibrium before any specialized.
Light and Darkness balanced each other, showing awareness and mystery coexisting.
Time appeared not as flow but as stillness - the moment before temporal sequence began.
Space manifested as infinite potential rather than defined dimension.
Order touched the edges to suggest the possibility of structure without actualizing it.
Division hovered at the periphery, representing the capacity to differentiate without yet doing so.
Ending paired with Beginning in a loop, showing that potential contains both initiation and conclusion.
All eighteen Core Phonemes were present in this single Genesis Principle.
But more than that, they were arranged into three distinct Logos that formed a complete sentence.
The first Logos combined Beginning, Void, Unity, and Paradox with specific conjugations that expressed: |What initiates in emptiness.|
The second Logos wove together Chaos, Life, Death, Time, and Space with syntax that declared: |Contains all possibilities without distinction.|
The third Logos unified Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, Darkness, Order, Division, and Ending in a structure that completed: |Until differentiation imposes form upon formlessness.|
Together, the three Logos created the full Philology:
|What initiates in emptiness contains all possibilities without distinction until differentiation imposes form upon formlessness.|
HUUM!
The complexity was breathtaking.
Each Phoneme pulsed with precise timing relative to the others.
Each Logos connected to the next through careful grammatical bridging.
The entire structure resonated with fundamental truth about the nature of Mana itself.
Ul’moreth’svoice resonated with profound depth as he spoke the complete Philology in The First Tongue.
The Logos pulsed with rhythm that felt older than time itself.

|This is the foundation of all Mana manipulation. Before Mana becomes fire or water, storm or hunger, it exists in this undifferentiated state. Understanding this Philology allows you to work with Mana at its most fundamental level. To reshape it before it takes any particular form. Once you grasp it, its full capabilities will show themselves to you.|
The manifestation allowed Noah a moment to absorb the first Genesis Principle before continuing, throwing this bundle of light to him be branded into his existence!
|The second Genesis Principle is: Temporal Perpetuity. This is Time as continuous flow rather than discrete moments. The understanding that past, present, and future are all one unbroken stream.|
The new PhilologyUl’morethwrote was equally complex.
Time appeared first, establishing the temporal foundation.
Unity wove through to show the unbroken nature of temporal flow.
Beginning and Ending intertwined in a loop, each containing the other.
Space manifested to show dimension across which time flows.
Order structured the sequence while Chaos introduced variation within continuity.
Life pulsed forward while Death pulled backward, creating tension that generated flow.
Paradox threaded throughout to express how past, present, and future exist simultaneously despite appearing sequential.
Void represented the gaps between moments that aren’t really gaps at all.
Light illuminated what was, is, and will be, while Darkness concealed the mechanisms of temporal progression.
Fire drove change forward as Water adapted to temporal currents.
Earth provided temporal stability while Air allowed temporal movement.
Division separated moments conceptually while Unity bound them into single stream.
Once again, all eighteen Core Phonemes appeared, but arranged into three distinct Logos.
The first Logos combined Time, Unity, Beginning, Ending, Space, and Order with conjugations expressing: |What flows without cease through all dimensions.|
The second Logos wove together Chaos, Life, Death, Paradox, and Void with syntax declaring: |Contains every moment within eternal now.|
The third Logos unified Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, Darkness, and Division in structure completing: |While appearing sequential yet remaining unified whole.|
The full Philology resonated:
|What flows without cease through all dimensions contains every moment within eternal now while appearing sequential yet remaining unified whole.|
Noah felt something shift in his perception as he absorbed this understanding.
The way he saw reality itself was changing.
Time wasn’t just a river flowing in one direction.
It was an ocean where past, present, and future existed as one body of water and one simply needed to swim in different areas. He already swam in different areas!
Ul’moreth gestured to the temporal Philology with reverence.

|This understanding is why temporal manipulation is possible. Time isn’t actually divided into separate moments. Those divisions are constructs we impose to make sense of existence. But the underlying reality is perpetual flow - one continuous stream. When you master this Philology, you don’t manipulate discrete moments. You work with the unified whole of temporal existence. You have been traversing through time in a way only you understand...|
The manifestation’s form began to dim slightly, its remaining energy focusing on the final lesson.
|The third Genesis Principle is: Existential Foundation. This is the bedrock upon which all reality constructs itself. The fundamental substrate that allows many things to BE.|
This final Philology was the most dense with meaning.
Earth appeared first as the core concept of foundation. Beginning established that foundation must exist before anything else can. Order provided the structure that foundation requires....
Unity, Space, Time, Life, Death, Fire...each added to it.
Air allowed foundation to remain permeable rather than rigid. Light revealed the foundation’s presence while Darkness protected its mysteries.
Void, Chaos, Division...
Ending paired with Beginning to show foundation supports both inception and conclusion.
All eighteen Core Phonemes wove together into three Logos of tremendous density.
The first Logos combined Earth, Beginning, Order, Unity, Space, and Time with precise conjugations expressing: |What grounds all being in structured persistence.|
The second Logos interwove Life, Death, Fire, Water, Air, and Void with complex syntax declaring: |Supports transformation and stillness equally.|
The third Logos unified Light, Darkness, Chaos, Division, Paradox, and Ending in architecture completing: |While permitting all contradictions to coexist upon bedrock of reality.|
The complete Philology pulsed with overwhelming weight:
|What grounds all being in structured persistence supports transformation and stillness equally while permitting all contradictions to coexist upon bedrock of reality.|
This final Genesis Principle seemed to vibrate with such fundamental truth that reality itself resonated in response!

chapters.title: Chapter 4649: THE Farewell of Ginnungagap IV
paragraphs: Ul’morethstepped back as all three complete Philologies floated in the air before Noah.
Each one was a masterwork of linguistic architecture.
Each one contained more than fifteen Phonemes arranged into at least three Logos that formed complete sentences.
Each one represented a fundamental truth about reality that transcended simple concepts.

|These are my Genesis Principles. The deepest understanding I achieved during my existence. Each one required eons to fully comprehend and construct. Each one represents the culmination of countless attempts, failures, and refinements. I give them to you now freely. Study the Philology. Reproduce the syntax. And they will become part of your own Weavings of Existence.|
The manifestation began to fade more rapidly now, its time clearly running short.

|You’ll notice that each Genesis Principle uses all eighteen Core Phonemes. This isn’t coincidence. A Genesis Principle must be complete - it must incorporate the full spectrum of fundamental concepts. Anything less is merely a Singularity Principle, no matter how refined.|
Ul’moreth’s eyes locked onto Noah’s with fierce intensity.

|The arrangement matters. The conjugations matter. The way the Logos connect into complete sentences matters. Change even one element and the entire meaning shifts. This is why Philology is so difficult to master.|
The manifestation raised one hand in final blessing.

|Remember. The First Tongue is not just power. It’s understanding. It’s the ability to perceive and reshape the fundamental structure of Existence itself. Use it well. Use it wisely. And perhaps... use it to create a better Existence than the one we failed to protect.|
The illusory form ofUl’morethsmiled one last time before dissolving completely into motes of obsidian-gold light.
The light flowed into Noah’s body as the chest itself crumbled to dust.
But the three complete Philologies remained floating in his consciousness.
Each one a sentence of tremendous complexity.
Each one using all eighteen Core Phonemes in precise grammatical arrangement.
Each one containing multiple Logos woven into unified meaning.
Prompts descended before Noah’s vision.
|Genesis Principles Glimpsed|

chapters.title: Chapter 4650: Glorious! I
paragraphs: Noah looked at the complex Philology floating in his mind with amazement!
All eighteen Core Phonemes arranged into three Logos forming a complete sentence.
|What initiates in emptiness contains all possibilities without distinction until differentiation imposes form upon formlessness.|
It felt so seamless and so easy as...
He raised his hand and began to inscribe the Philology in the space before him.
His fingers moved with practiced grace as blue-gold light followed their path.
Beginning, Void, Unity, Paradox...
The Phonemes manifested one after another with increasing ease.
Chaos, Life, Death, Fire, Water, Earth, Air...
And then something remarkable just like before happened!
The inscription became shockingly easy.
Not because the Philology was simple - it was devastatingly complex.
But because Undifferentiated Mana was just
...his Mana.
This entire Genesis Principle wss just his Mana.
The fundamental potential that preceded all specialization.
The primordial state before form imposed itself upon formlessness.
This was what he’d been learnign since Ginnungagap.
This was what he’d shown Lumivara.
He just hadn’t knownthe elevated immensity of The First Tongue that described it.
Light, Darkness, Time, Space, Order, Division, Ending.
The final Phonemes fell into place as the complete Philology blazed before him.
And then pure blue brilliance erupted all around him.
Not blue-gold like his Primus Mana usually manifested.
Just pure, pristine blue.
The color of Mana itself in its most fundamental state.
The brilliance formed into flower-like patterns that bloomed and spread.
Rivers of blue light branched outward across existence like living tributaries.
Each river pulsed with undifferentiated potential seeking form.
The branching rivers spread across the Transcendent Helios Fold, touching everything they encountered.
And then they began flowing back.
All these rivers joined into a single pillar of brilliant blue light that flowed directly into Noah.
The sensation was overwhelming.
His entire body became surrounded by the Philology of Undifferentiated Mana.
The complete sentence spun around him like a hymn being sung by reality itself.
|What initiates in emptiness contains all possibilities without distinction until differentiation imposes form upon formlessness.|
The words pulsed with each rotation around his body.
Each Phoneme resonated with perfect clarity.
Each Logos connected seamlessly to the next.
The full Philology created a symphony of linguistic power that restructured his very existence.
Prompts descended before his vision in cascading brilliance.
|GENESIS PRINCIPLE GRASPED|
|Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana - ACHIEVED|
|Mastery Level: 50% (Instant Comprehension)|
|Classification: Your innate nature aligned perfectly with this Philology.You have exceeded Basic Mastery and attained Intermediate Mastery instantly.|
|Explanation:|
|This Genesis Principle describes the fundamental nature of Mana before specialization|
|You have been teaching and embodying this concept since your emergence|
|The Philology simply provided the elevated grammatical structure to express what you already understood|
|Result: Instant mastery. The only reason it is not 100% is because The First Tongue itself still holds many complexities and intricacies|
|EXISTENTIAL REFINEMENT INITIATED|
|The innate passive existential refinement of your existence has begun by an authority of The First Tongue|
|Your Weavings are being restructured at the substrate level|
|All aspects of your being are being optimized according to proper linguistic grammar|
|DEPTH REFINEMENT IN PROGRESS|
|Your Depth of Absolute Sovereignty of Mana and Hunger which have not been declared officially|
|Yet you hold the immensity of THE Surface Depth equivalent weight|
|Both are now under refinement with the Philology of The First Tongue|
|FOUNDATION REINFORCEMENT|
|THE Foundation of The First Tongue is being refined by Genesis Principle comprehension|
|Your Foundation now incorporates Genesis-level understanding|
|This creates compound effects with all other abilities|
|All Logos you form will carry traces of Genesis Principle architecture|
|All Mana you manipulate will reflect undifferentiated nature before specialization|
|CIVILIZATIONAL IMPACT|
|Your Primordial Civilization of Mana and Hunger resonates with this achievement|
|All entities within your Civilization receive passive benefit|
|Mana manipulation efficiency: +340% for all members|
|Way development acceleration: +450% for all members|
|These effects persist as long as you maintain Genesis Principle mastery|
Additional prompts bloomed with tremendous significance.
|The Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana grants the following capabilities:|
|Feature 1 - Way Manifestation:|
|You alone, due to your nature, can exhibit any Way of Existence through this Genesis Principle|
|By accessing undifferentiated potential, you can temporarily specialize into any form|
|Duration: Variable based on complexity of Way|
|Limitation: Cannot permanently adopt Ways that conflict with your core nature|
|Application: Allows you to demonstrate, teach, or utilize any Way as needed|
|Feature 2 - Way Alteration (Benevolent):|
|You can change the Ways of others in non-harmful manner through this Principle|
|By returning their Way to undifferentiated state, you can help them reshape it|
|This requires their willing cooperation and cannot be forced|
|Applications:|
|- Correcting flaws in another’s Way development|
|- Helping entities transition between Ways safely|
|- Optimizing Way efficiency by rebuilding from foundation|
|- Removing harmful influences or corruption from Ways|
|Limitation: Cannot alter Ways against the entity’s will or nature|
|Feature 3 - Pedagogical Amplification:|
|When you teach Ways or aid in the progression of others, you receive amplified returns|
|The more effectively you teach, the greater the harvest|
|Students’ breakthroughs generate Infinite Potential that flows back to you|
|This creates a cycle of teaching and advancement|
|Harvest Multipliers:|
|- Basic teaching (sharing knowledge): +200% harvest|
|- Active guidance (personalized instruction): +500% harvest|
|- Breakthrough facilitation (enabling major advancement): +1,200% harvest|
|- Genesis comprehension (student grasps Genesis-level truth): +3,000,000% harvest|
|Feature 4 - Existential Resistance Enhancement:|
|50% Mastery of this Genesis Principle immediately grants Intermediate Understanding (40% Philology Mastery equivalent)|
|Your passive defense against attacks has increased substantially|
|THE Surface Depth attacks are now significantly weakened before reaching you, and may find it hard to harm you|
|Feature 5 - Mana Primacy:|
|All Mana-based attacks you perform now carry Genesis-level authority|
|Your Mana operates at the substrate level beneath specialized forms|
|This allows your attacks to bypass resistances based on specialized Sovereignties|
|Example: An entity immune to fire cannot fully resist your Mana-based fire because you’re working with the potential that precedes fire|
|Feature 6 - Way Evolution:|
|You can now guide the evolution of your own Way with unprecedented precision|
|By returning aspects of your Way to undifferentiated state, you can reshape them optimally|
|This allows continuous refinement rather than being locked into early development choices|
|Your Way of Mana and Hunger can now evolve dynamically based on need|
Oh!
Oh!!!
Noah smiled as he processed all of these prompts.
He could exhibit any Way of Existence by accessing undifferentiated potential.
He could help others reshape their Ways safely and benevolently.
And most importantly, when he taught others, he received amplified returns.
Pedagogical Amplification.
He thought aboutUl’morethteaching him.
DidUl’morethgain tremendous returns from that teaching?
He hoped theInfinite Potentialthere was immense.
Ul’morethdeserved as much as he needed, especially since he was locked inTHE Belly of Existencethis whole time.
The thought made Noah’s smile grow wider.
If teaching generated such powerful returns, thenUl’moreth’ssacrifice to save Noah fromTHE Primordial Chaoswould have created even more.
The causality there was profound.
A teacher saves his student by burning his Way.
The student later brings the teacher’s Genesis Principles to full comprehension.
The loop completes itself with both parties benefiting from the connection.
The blue brilliance surrounding Noah began to stabilize.
The Philology of Undifferentiated Mana had fully integrated into his Weavings.
His Foundation was reinforced beyond what should be possible at his current classification.
His Depths of Mana and Hunger Sovereignty were being refined to absolute purity.
And he’d gained capabilities that would allow him to exhibit any Way, reshape others’ Ways, and harvest tremendous potential through teaching.
All from grasping a single Genesis Principle.
He still had two more to master fromUl’moreth’steachings.
Temporal Perpetuity and Existential Foundation.
And beyond those, he had nine Core Phonemes of his own to create as THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons, and Perpetual Harvest and Cheating Architect to take to Genesis.
The path ahead was clear.
And with the Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana now fully grasped, that path had become significantly more achievable!
Noah looked over at The First Farmer, still blazing with effort as he constructed his first Phoneme.
He considered using Way Manifestation to demonstrate the process more clearly.
Or using Way Alteration to help optimize The First Farmer’s approach.
But he held back.
The First Farmer needed to achieve this himself for now for the harvest to be meaningful.
Teaching was most effective when the student struggled and overcame.
Easy answers created shallow understanding.
So Noah simply sat and observed, ready to offer guidance if truly needed.
While around him, the pure blue rivers of Undifferentiated Mana continued to flow.
He was thinking that maybe, before The Fallout...he needed to take the role of a Teacher...and teach on The First Tongue to all those in The Infiniverse.

The path ahead was clear.
And with the Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana now fully grasped, that path had become significantly more achievable!
Noah looked over at The First Farmer, still blazing with effort as he constructed his first Phoneme.
He considered using Way Manifestation to demonstrate the process more clearly.
Or using Way Alteration to help optimize The First Farmer’s approach.
But he held back.
The First Farmer needed to achieve this himself for now for the harvest to be meaningful.
Teaching was most effective when the student struggled and overcame.
Easy answers created shallow understanding.
So Noah simply sat and observed, ready to offer guidance if truly needed.
While around him, the pure blue rivers of Undifferentiated Mana continued to flow.
He was thinking that maybe, before The Fallout...he needed to take the role of a Teacher...and teach on The First Tongue to all those in The Infiniverse.

paragraphs: Noah put the idea of teaching on his to-do list.
For now, he wanted complete access to the remaining Genesis Principles.
The blue rivers ofUndifferentiated Manastill flowed around him as he turned his attention to the second Philology floating in his mind.
Temporal Perpetuity.
All eighteen Core Phonemes arranged into three Logos forming a complete sentence.
|What flows without cease through all dimensions contains every moment within eternal now while appearing sequential yet remaining unified whole.|
He raised his hand and began to inscribe the Philology in the space before him.
Time appeared first, establishing the temporal foundation.
Unity wove through to show the unbroken nature of temporal flow.
Beginning and Ending intertwined in a loop, each containing the other.
The Phonemes manifested with building momentum as Noah felt the rhythm of this Genesis Principle.
Space, Order, Chaos, Life, Death, Paradox, Void...
The inscription came easier than he expected, though not as seamlessly as Undifferentiated Mana.
This wasn’t his fundamental nature the way pure Mana was.
But it connected to something he’d experienced directly.
Temporal Traversal.
The closed temporal loop that sent him back to Ginnungagap and The Infinite Unfurling.
He’d lived the truth that past, present, and future weren’t separate at all.
Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, Darkness, Division.
The final Phonemes fell into place as the complete Philology blazed before him.
And then crystalline purple amber brilliance erupted all around him.
Not blue like Undifferentiated Mana.
This was the color of Time itself as it pulsed through reality.
The brilliance formed into spiraling patterns that looped back on themselves.
Rivers of amber purple light flowed both forward and backward simultaneously, creating impossible geometries.
Each river represented a moment in time, yet all moments existed at once.
The spiraling rivers expanded across the Transcendent Helios Fold before converging.
They formed into a massive crystalline structure that resembled an hourglass, but the sand flowed in all directions at once.
The structure descended into Noah’s chest.
The sensation was different from Undifferentiated Mana.
Not overwhelming potential, but rather the feeling of standing at the center of infinite temporal streams.
His entire body became surrounded by thePhilology of Temporal Perpetuity.
|What flows without cease through all dimensions contains every moment within eternal now while appearing sequential yet remaining unified whole.|
The words pulsed with temporal rhythm that felt like the heartbeat of existence itself.
Prompts descended before his vision in cascading amber purple light.
|Genesis Principle Grasped|
|Genesis Principle of Temporal Perpetuity - Achieved|
|Mastery Level: 35%|
|Classification: Your experience with Temporal Traversal provided direct understanding of unified temporal flow|
|Explanation:|
|This Genesis Principle describes Time as continuous stream rather than discrete moments|
|Your Temporal Traversal to The Infinite Unfurling demonstrated this truth experientially|
|You lived through the paradox of being in both past and present simultaneously|
|Existential Refinement Enhanced|
|Your temporal perception has been restructured at the substrate level|
|You now perceive time’s true nature even while experiencing it sequentially|
|This creates passive temporal awareness that cannot be disrupted|
|Foundation Reinforcement|
|THE Foundation of The First Tongue incorporates the second Genesis Principle|
|Compound effects with Undifferentiated Mana creating synergistic enhancement|
|All temporal abilities now carry Genesis-level authority|
Additional prompts bloomed with tremendous significance.
|The Genesis Principle of Temporal Perpetuity grants the following capabilities:|
|Feature 1 - Early Atlas Enhancement:|
|Your Early Atlas of The Folds gains Genesis-level temporal authority|
|Temporal Traversal capability enhanced beyond normal parameters|
|You can now navigate temporal streams with unprecedented precision|
|The "closed loop" restriction becomes more flexible - you can identify and potentially create new stable loops|
|Temporal resistance increased - entities attempting to disrupt your position in time face Genesis-level opposition|
|The Atlas itself becomes anchored across all moments simultaneously|
|Feature 2 - Infinite Desmoterion Temporal Expansion:|
|THE Infinite Desmoterion’stime dilation has been fundamentally enhanced|
|Previous dilation: 27,000x faster than external reality|
|Enhanced dilation: Variable up to 270,000x based on need|
|This enhancement appliesretroactively- all prisoners have been cultivating under improved conditions|
|Temporal stability within the prison dimension increased substantially|
|Prisoners can now safely cultivate across longer subjective time periods without degradation|
|The harvest from their advancement will be proportionally greater|
|Feature 3 - Temporal Perpetuity Sovereign Spires:|
|Your Sovereign Spires of Osmont gain a new classification option|
|Entities who have undergone Civilization Specialization can now enter Temporal Perpetuity Spires|
|Within these Spires, time flows according to the cultivator’s need|
|They can spend subjective years cultivating their Ways while mere hours pass externally|
|The dilation is personalized - each cultivator experiences optimal temporal flow for their development|
|Maximum dilation per individual: 50,000x (increases with their mastery)|
|This creates a Civilization-wide advantage in advancement speed|
|Note: Only those who have proven loyalty through Civilization Specialization can access this feature|
Noah absorbed these prompts with shining eyes.
The Temporal Perpetuity Sovereign Spires alone would revolutionize his Civilization’s development.
Entities could cultivate for subjective decades while only hours or days passed in reality.
Combined with the enhanced Infinite Desmoterion, his entire power base was accelerating.
But he wasn’t finished yet.
He turned his attention to the third and final Genesis Principle fromUl’moreth’steachings.
Existential Foundation.
|What grounds all being in structured persistence supports transformation and stillness equally while permitting all contradictions to coexist upon bedrock of reality.|
He raised his hand once more and began to inscribe.
Earth appeared first as the core concept of foundation.
Beginning, Order, Unity, Space, Time...
The Phonemes manifested with building solidity.
This one felt different from both previous Genesis Principles.
Not fundamental like Undifferentiated Mana.
Not experiential like Temporal Perpetuity.
This was architectural.
The understanding that reality required structure to exist upon.
Life, Death, Fire, Water, Air, Void, Light, Darkness, Chaos, Division, Paradox, Ending.
The final Phonemes locked into place as the complete Philology blazed before him.
And then solid bronze radiance erupted all around him.
The color of Earth itself,representing an unshakable foundation.
But the manifestation was unlike the previous two Genesis Principles.
Instead of rivers or spirals, geometric patterns began forming in the air.
Blueprint lines of bronze light sketched out architectural designs.
Foundations, walls, support beams, chambers, and connecting passages.
The designs descended into Noah’s body, specifically into his mind where THE Organ of Civilization pulsed.
And then something extraordinary happened.
The bronze light didn’t just enhance what was already there.
It began constructing something entirely new within his existence.
A metaphysical structure that would serve as the true foundation for everything he was building!

THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons.

Around him, three Genesis Principles pulsed in harmony. Blue potential, amber perpetuity, and bronze foundation.
The building blocks of existence itself, now flowing through Noah’s Weavings!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4653: The First Lesson I
paragraphs: Noah looked within himself as he sawTHE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons.
His lineage was that ofTHE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons, and hisTHE Foundation of The First Tongueheld a physical construct now.
THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsexisted in his mind nearTHE Organ of Civilizationthat had also finished its initial development.
He had so many capitalTHEsassociated with him now.
If he wanted to officially enter THE Surface Depth of his Way and Civilization, he could do it instantly as his body already held its power.
But he wanted to see something first. He wanted to see how immense his Foundation could be!
So he simply said.
"Let me see."
HUUM!
In the next moment,THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsemerged externally.
Shockingly, it appeared above him and extended across the budding Transcendent Helios Folds in The Infiniverse.
His Grimoire stretched out for an entire gigaparsec!
The sheer scale was breathtaking.
It looked grand beyond description as it shined with blue-gold radiance that illuminated the entire region.
The covers were ornate beyond anything Noah had seen.
Infinity symbols covered every surface in intricate patterns that shifted and reformed constantly.
The symbols wove together in fractal designs, each one containing smaller infinity symbols within themselves.
The edges of the book pulsed with linguistic power as Phonemes danced along the binding.
The spine showed all eighteen Core Phonemes arranged vertically, glowing with their respective colors.
Blue-gold flames for Fire, liquid silver for Water, solid bronze for Earth, and so on down the entire spectrum.
The covers themselves seemed to be constructed from compressed Logos, thousands upon thousands of sentences woven so tightly they formed solid material.
Noah looked at this book with shining eyes.
He could instinctively feel how to use it.
This Grimoire was actually a deadly weapon.
Its pages filled with The First Tongue could be manifested as devastating attacks.
The expression of power was unique.
For the Genesis Principles, he could express them in a myriad of ways.
He could even cause the emergence of Glyphs for them, just like the thousands of glyphs that he had branded to himself with Perpetual Harvest and Cheating Architect and Mana Supremacy and others.
But the glyphs, as he was realizing right now, seemed to be a lesser form of expression of the Principles when one didn’t properly understand that they came from The First Tongue.
And because they didn’t know that the glyphs were simplified Weavings, that allowed better usage of the Principles but not optimal usage.
When the Civilizations ofTHE Creature and THE Living Existenceswere made, they made glyphs widespread instead of trying to teach The First Tongue.
Why was this?
Of course, even though he asked, he knew that it was an impossibility for entities that had not obtainedTHE Surface Depthto be utilizing The First Tongue.
And there had to be anomalies here and there for them to be capable of doing it.
But if there was access to better power, Noah didn’t want his people to simply learn a simpler version of it.
Even if it would be hard and arduous, let them work hard and let them struggle.
And the power they could obtain at the end of the struggle would be immense.
As he was thinking all of this, he held the musings and the access of three Genesis Principles.
And he was at this moment breaking down the Logos that made up The Principle of Perpetual Harvest and The Principle of the Cheating Architect among the five that he had prior.
The Principles of Mana Supremacy, Arcana Infinitum, and Primus Ascension that he obtained from his isolated Civilization of Mana led by Kael and Riya seemed to have similar meaning.

When he was looking at these and their Logos, their elevations may actually be fused into the Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana.

The First Farmer opened his eyes.
And in his hands floated the Phoneme of Fire, clearly written and manifesting with perfect clarity.
His expression showed pure elation and wonder.
He looked towards Noah with eyes shining with such bright green-gold light that they could be their own suns.
His voice emerged with trembling glory.

His voice filled with maddened fervor towards the very end.
The very Weavings of existence of this being were already spilling past Pre-THE, trying to find foothold on a Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
The green-gold light around him intensified as his entire existence trembled with building power.

If and when he managed to string together Logos and get access to his first Genesis Principle, and due to his Anomalous Factor of THE SEED, The First Farmer would finally truly be capable of attainingTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
It would be a long time coming after eons of failure.
But the path was finally clear.
Noah nodded to The First Farmer as he rose up.
He could feel the breakdown of the Principles of Perpetual Harvest and the Cheating Architect happening in the background.
All of them would actually be completed and elevated to become Genesis Principles in the next few minutes.
While this happened, he turned his gaze up and observed the radiantTHE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsfar above him.
Its size began to reduce as it floated towards the palm of his hand.
He began to float upward as he voiced out to The First Farmer.
"I shall be teaching upon and expanding upon The First Tongue. You should also be able to benefit, so let’s go."
The gigaparsec-spanning book continued shrinking as it descended.
From a construct visible across entire Folds, it reduced to the size of a building, then a house, then just large enough to fit in his hands.
The blue-gold radiance never dimmed despite the size reduction.
The infinity symbols on the covers continued their eternal dance.
Noah graspedTHE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsas it settled into his palm.
The weight felt perfect.
Not too heavy, not too light.
It pulsed with his heartbeat as if it were an extension of his body.
Which, in a sense, it was.
This wasTHE Foundation of The First Tonguemade manifest.
The literal architecture of his power given physical form.
He could open it and read the Chapters dedicated to each Phoneme.
He could add new pages as he mastered new Logos.
He could watch as entire new Chapters wrote themselves when he created his nine personal Phonemes.
And eventually, when he reached Absolute Depth,THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconswould become...well, he would wait for it.
A new dialect of The First Tongue that bore his name.
THE Osmontian Tongue, perhaps.
Or THE Lexicon of Genesis.
Something that would mark his existence as a fundamental force within reality.
But that was for the future.
For now, he had teaching to do.
Noah turned and began moving through the Transcendent Helios Folds with The First Farmer following behind.
Blue potential, amber perpetuity, and bronze foundation swirled around him.
THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsrested in his hand, and in the background of his existence, Perpetual Harvest and Cheating Architect were being reconstructed at the Genesis level!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4654: The First Lesson II
paragraphs: In Existence, teachers were rare.
Not instructors who recited facts or demonstrated techniques. Not mentors who shared their experience or guided development.
But true teachers who fundamentally changed how their students perceived reality itself.
Across the countless eons of Observable Existence, entities had risen to power through struggle, through theft, through inheritance, through luck.
Very few had risen through genuine teaching.
The pessimistic truth was that most who claimed the title of teacher were frauds.
They hoarded knowledge to maintain advantage over students.
They shared just enough to seem generous while keeping the best insights for themselves.
They created dependency rather than independence, ensuring students always needed to return.
This was the Way of Existence.
Knowledge was power, and power was not freely given.
Even amongTHE Living Existenceswho’d formed the grand Civilizations, how many truly taught?
They never taught the underlying truth to the vast masses, only to a select few who had the talent for it.
Teachers who truly taught, who genuinely elevated their students without reservation, who shared the deepest truths without holding back...
These were so rare as to be almost nonexistent.
And then, there was THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons!

In The Early Veiled Shore of The Infiniverse, having put The Fallout in the back of his mind while he focused on communicating with The Infiniverse, Noah appeared above the skies of the place that used to be a small island with golden sands.
And he was communicating with The Infiniverse as she proceeded to forgeTHE Infinite Loom.
Because this was the barrier of protection against The Fallout. The answer was not attainingTHE Civilizational Authorityor raw power alone.
It was unknown even if someone heldTHE Surface Depth or THE Intermediate Depthwhether they would survive wheneverTHE Living Paradoxactivated his weapon againstTHE Creature.
The weapon that would carve outTHE Belly of Existenceand unleash everything that was locked in the prison ofTHE Creature.
Ul’morethand all others imprisoned there.
When it came to that future, Noah was actually expectant and cautious for it.
It meant an eruption of entities withTHEpower, and who knew what the landscape would be after The Fallout.
But in preparing for it, he wasn’t just utilizingTHE Civilizational Authorityor filling up the barrier of The Infiniverse withTHE Civilizational Units of Everything of Mana.
He was having The Infiniverse inscribe Logos of The First Tongue itself in its periphery.
And because no matter whatTHE Living Paradoxsought to destroy, he couldn’t destroy The First Tongue itself.
At this very moment, the peripheral barrier of his home was being inscribed with Logos of The First Tongue.
And he was also personally moving with another body near The Infiniverse to inscribe thePhilology of his Genesis Principleson it as well!
The Philology of Existence... could anyone destroy it?
It would be akin to destroying the very structures that made up The First Tongue itself.
The main opponent ofTHE Living Paradox was THE Creature.
And after knowing everything that he now knew regarding how obsceneTHE Creaturewas, Noah had to give props toTHE Living Paradoxfor even daring to do what he was doing.
He was still a shitty guy and one of his main enemies.
And of course, Noah didn’t forget about his ultimate and most sworn enemy in Existence...THE Living Elemental!
The man who put a curse of burning on him and made him leave his harem momentarily.
He would hunt this fucking guy to the very ends of Existence after he came out ofTHE Loom.
As he had such thoughts, some in The Early Veiled Shore were already looking up at him.
He shook his head and got back to his purpose here.
He looked down at the radiant golden sands of this expansive and endless continent as he saw many things.
He saw his Abode that used to be the Abode of The Early Creature, but now it wasThe Abode of THE Genesis Monarch.
He saw the aquariums that were holding multiple radiant Marine Lifeforms.
He saw the many fields and trees and plots that were filled with Sacred Herbs.
The massive figure of Yoshinami rested in a corner, and Heidrun grazed in a green-gold field while Malphas obtained Sacred Mead from her and also looked up.
He saw Riya, whose eyes burned brightly with Mana as she was currently smiling.
He didn’t even have to ask her whether she saw Mana still dimming or not to know why she smiled.
And he saw the figures ofTorand Khor as they were looking at the Sanctuaries of Primus Inevitabilities.
He sawTHE Living Originwith Sigrid leading her and introducing her to Amelia Osmont.
He saw The Queen of Matter and Night recording everything as if they were possessed.
At such a time, he looked at the closed book within his hands and spoke out.
|Gather.|
HUUM!
The word was spoken not in normal language, but in the language of The First Tongue!
Tor and THE Living Originunderstood it since these beings were exposed to The First Tongue after all of these eons and very likely knew the Phonemes already.
But to the others, it should be and feel completely foreign.
And yet, Noah chose to speak in this voice.
Because his Way was The Way of Mana.
His Civilization was that of Mana, as every single creature before him held Mana coursing through their veins.

Just like he was able to understand The First Tongue and speak it with his Mana, even though his people might stumble and struggle to understand initially, he was doing them a favor by speaking in this language from the beginning.
If their Civilizational potential and their talent were profound enough, they would understand him rather quickly.
And if they didn’t have enough potential or talent, they would struggle.
But eventually they would pick it up.
For he didn’t plan to have his Civilization be a weak one.
Because Existence was not fair.
Existence was such a profound struggle that even now, he wanted to do everything he could to make sure that a time never came similar to before.
When he stood beforeTHE Primordial Chaos or THE Living Temporal, and he wasn’t able to do a thing.
He didn’t want that feeling of helplessness in himself or in his people.
They had to struggle. They had to persevere.
HUUM!
Noah floated down gently, coming to sit on the massive construct ofThe Abode of THE Genesis Monarch.
He looked at those standing on the golden sands and throughout the regions of The Early Veiled Shore.
He looked at all of them as he raised a book.
THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons.
His Foundation of The First Tongue made manifest.
His figure looked glorious as his blue-gold robe pulsed with radiance.
The floating blue-gold crown above his head pulsed with bursts of Fragments of Phonemes of The First Tongue.
His entire figure gave off a truly imposing feel, even to his own people who’d grown accustomed to his power.
This was different.
This was the appearance of a true Sovereign about to impart knowledge that would reshape their very existence.
He spoke with grand and imposing tone.

|Our enemies are stronger than us. Existence is stronger than us. We have to play catch-up in order to simply stand before them. And the way to do this is to struggle and to learn. The weapon that will allow you to stand tall against monstrous creatures that have lived for eons... is The First Tongue.|
BOOM!
His words were heavy and booming as they echoed across The Early Veiled Shore.
At this moment, countless entities within the region turned their attention fully to him.
All of their eyes locked onto his figure.
Even the figures ofTor and THE Living Originhad eyes filled with a light that seemed to be asking... just what was he about to do?
Because The First Tongue was something that could truly only be utilized by those who held a Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
He would try and teach it to the masses?
The scene was glorious as Noah raised the book in his hands.
He looked like an ancient primordial emperor giving a sermon to his subjects!
His voice emerged with imposing and tyrannical authority as he explained.

|The First Tongue is not energy. It is not power in the traditional sense. It is language. The fundamental grammar that structures all of reality. Every Way of Existence, every Principle, every expression of authority... all of it stems from The First Tongue. The glyphs we have been using are simplified expressions. Useful, yes. But limited. They are training wheels. And I refuse to let my Civilization ride with training wheels when you could be flying.|
He paused, letting the words sink in.

|Learning The First Tongue will be difficult. Many of you will struggle. Some may fail initially. But those who persevere, those who truly grasp even a single Phoneme, will find their power elevated beyond what glyphs could ever provide. You will be speaking the language of Existence itself. And Existence will have no choice but to listen.|
His eyes blazed with blue-gold light.
|I will not coddle you. I will not simplify things beyond what is necessary for comprehension. You will struggle, and through that struggle, you will grow stronger than you ever imagined possible.|
Noah broughtTHE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsin front of him.
He opened its cover as brilliant light spilled forth.
The first page rose up and began to shine with intense blue-gold radiance tinged with pure flame.
Noah voiced out grandly.
|The first lesson is that of Fire. The Phoneme of Fire.|
BOOM!
The page expanded, growing larger until the Phoneme of Fire was visible to all gathered entities.
Blue-gold flames danced across the surface, forming intricate patterns that seemed to burn yet create rather than destroy.

|Fire is not merely flame. It is transformation. It is energy unleashed. It is the force that changes one state of being into another. When you master the Phoneme of Fire, you don’t just create flames. You speak the concept of transformation itself into reality.|
Noah raised his hand as the Phoneme manifested above his palm.
|Watch. Learn. And when you are ready, attempt to recreate what you see. Struggle. Struggle. Struggle!|
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4655: The Fallen and The Scheming
paragraphs: While a Monarch began to teach in one corner of Observable Existence, in The Lands of The Dead, something entirely different was unfolding.
The region was expansive beyond measure, stretching across dimensions that normal entities couldn’t perceive.
Order and Death intertwined in perfect harmony here.
Obsidian structures rose alongside white marble monuments, creating a checkerboard pattern that extended infinitely.
The air itself pulsed with the authority of finality and structure combined.
At the very center of this domain, a massive obsidian-white throne could be seen.
Currently, it sat fractured.
Cracks ran through its surface like spiderwebs, and pieces had fallen away to reveal the emptiness beneath.
Sprawled on it while wailing and crying was none other thanTHE Dead Order.
Well, she really couldn’t be given a capitalTHEanymore.
Just The Dead Order now.
If anyone were to see her current state of being, they would be filled with a sense of sadness.
There was a truth about existence that few wanted to acknowledge.
Whenever a time came that entities who used to be majestic and grand and glorious fell from their high pedestals, the loss of majesty wasn’t always something to make fun of or revel in.
More often than not, it was actually a sad affair.
For if such a majestic entity could lose all their majesty and immensity, what did that mean for the rest of existence?
What did that mean for those who were weaker, less established, more vulnerable?
In Existence, nothing was guaranteed.
Even if you thought you had the backing of Existence itself, even if you’d made pacts withTHE Creature, even if you’d given everything you were to a greater cause...
Nothing was guaranteed.
The Dead Order thought that she had the backing of Existence itself.
So everything should and would flow as it was supposed to.
Her current state was pitiful.
Her hair, once immaculately arranged in perfect white braids adorned with obsidian ornaments, now hung disheveled and tangled around her face.
Her robes, which used to shimmer with the authority of Death and Order combined, were torn and stained.
Her eyes, which once held the cold certainty of inevitable endings structured perfectly, now seemed hollow and cracked at the edges.
She raised her head with messy hair falling across her face and voiced out with a sense of pain that cut through the silence.

"Ever since I was first collapsed, I was not the same. Even if we call what we have Primordial Civilizations, the moment that we are collapsed, even if we recover and come back... we’re never the same. It’s as if we lost something critical just by being collapsed. I gave you my weight. I gave you my love. To Existence itself... and yet I was still collapsed."
Her voice became more strained, more desperate.

"You made promises to me. You brought me back. You had always kept your promises. But why is it that you did not keep your promises this time around?! Why did you not collapse Osmont as you said you would?! Why did you allow him to stand before me with such tyranny and take everything from me?! I was loyal! I was faithful! I gaveEVERYTHING!"
The words became more chaotic and emotional as she spoke, her body trembling.
She was veering off towards psychological breakdown.
The signs were clear in every aspect of her being.
Her hands shook uncontrollably as they gripped the armrests of her fractured throne.
Her breathing became rapid and irregular, each inhale a gasping sob.
Tears streamed down her face, but they weren’t normal tears.
They were fragments of her Weavings themselves, pieces of her existence literally crying out.
She looked up towards the expanse of white and obsidian all around her.
And she roared out.
"WHY, O CREATURE?! WHY?! I gave you My Everything. My Everything! So why did you not collapse Osmont?!"
Her eyes and face began cracking as she spoke.
Literal fissures appeared across her skin, glowing with unstable light.
Her Way and Civilization truly having been drawn out and siphoned off far too much.
And in her current Weavings of Existence, it looked like everything was crumbling.
If she did not stop this frenzied state, everything about her may just crumble completely once more.
She would collapse again.
And this time, there might be no coming back.
"WHY?!" she roared one last time.
And as the word left her mouth, brilliant multicolored light descended from above.
It wrapped around her disheveled head gently, almost tenderly.
Her eyes dimmed as the light touched her, the frenzy fading into sudden calm.
Right after, her body slumped forward.
But before she could fall from the throne entirely, the multicolored light caught her.
Her figure was straightened up as she began to float above her throne.
Logos bloomed all around her, manifesting in The First Tongue.
They formed into radiant sentences smoothly that created a cocoon around her body.
The cocoon shined brilliantly with restorative power, beginning to mend the cracks in her existence.
And then immense silence spread out in the surroundings.
The wailing stopped.
The breakdown ceased.
All that remained was the sight of a once-glorious entity being held together by forces beyond her control.
A fall from grace was never something grand or something to make fun of.
More often than not, it was unfathomably sad to see such wasted potential and possibilities.
What could The Dead Order have become if she’d chosen a different path?
What heights could she have reached if she hadn’t given everything toTHE Creature’sdesigns?
Now she was just another casualty in the conflicts of supreme beings.
Another piece broken on a board she’d never truly understood.
WithinTHE Loom, in a region far removed from The Dead Order’s domain, a sea stretched endlessly.
But this was no ordinary sea.
It was surrounded by immensely concentrated elements that were filled with different variations of The First Tongue.
Flames that spoke in Fire Phonemes.
Waters that flowed in liquid sentences.
Air that whispered complex Logos.
Earth that solidified into grammatical structures.
Inside such a place, there was a humanoid figure blazing with multicolored radiance.
The figure couldn’t be clearly observed, as if reality itself refused to fully render his form.
But radiant gold flames burned on his forehead, marking him unmistakably.
This wasTHE Living Elemental.
His expression was currently that of annoyance.
He had an unexpected visitor in his domain that he looked towards right now.
His gaze made it clear that he wanted to be alone and did not want her here.
Yet this being,THE Living Emotive, acted completely oblivious.
She even said with casual irreverence.

"You can fucking look at me annoyed all you want, and I will still do whatever the fuck I want, big guy. Just shut up and listen as I came here to vent. What was I saying? Ah yes, Five Seconds to Midnight. The showdown between THE Living Paradox and THE Creature gets ever closer, and do you know how I feel as it’s coming? I actually feel expectant and euphoric to fully see THE Creature again. I find myself asking, what exactly will he do? Would he come find those like me and you and collapse us first, or leave us alone and write us off as too weak for him? Haha!"
Her words were manic and filled with chaotic emotions as she continued.

"You know, many are getting it wrong thinking that somehow, after the eruption of THE Loom, the battle will be decided right then and there. It will actually just be the start. Because as much as this is a battle between Paradox and Existence, it is also a battle between THE Primordial Chaos, THE Secretive Eon, and those other fuckers we don’t even know about yet. So... what about those like you and me?"
As she said this, she floated towardsTHE Living Elemental.
Shockingly, she came to put the back of her head on his shoulder.
She looked at his eyes from mere inches away, her expression unreadable.

"Those like you and I... do we not have a place in all this? Will we account for anything in Existence? Do you... want to account for anything at all? Or will you be this feeble man always in the shadow of THE Creature? The shadow of THE Living Paradox? You’re all grand monuments of Existence, you’re all so... big. And yet you, Elemental... seem so tiny. So feeble compared to them. Hell, you have so much backing in the Phonemes of The First Tongue, and yet... you are down here. Don’t you want to change this?"
The words were heavy and manipulative, designed to cut at insecurities.
THE Living Elemental’sresponse came calm and imposing.

"I know my size, Emotive. I know exactly how big I am and where I stand in the hierarchy of Existence. Your manipulations won’t work on me because I’m not deluded about my position. I chose to remain here in THE Loom. I chose...what I chose rather than playing games with THE Creature and THE Living Paradox. Do not mistake my choices for weakness."
HUUM!
He paused before continuing with even more imposing authority.
"And you need to get the fuck off of me. Now."
THE Living Emotivesmiled and moved her head away.
She floated in front ofTHE Living Elemental,her expression shifting to something almost predatory.

"I could help you and help myself. For those like you and me to not just be nothing. To matter even before The Oldest Paradox of Existence. Do you want to know how? You could have everything THE Living Paradox and THE Creature held. You could even... have me. In the deepest parts of your existence, you’ve always wanted to have me, didn’t you? I could always sense your emotions..."
Silence descended.
THE Living Elementallooked atEmotivecalmly.
His multicolored radiance pulsed once before he spoke.
"What the hell have you done? What are you planning now?"
At these words,THE Living Emotivesimply smiled devilishly.
Her eyes glinted with schemes within schemes.
And she said absolutely nothing.
The silence that followed was more terrifying than any answer could have been!

chapters.title: Chapter 4656: Paradox and Chaos
paragraphs: The sea of Paradox had never been more resplendent.
It stretched across dimensions that defied conventional measurement. Its depths contained contradictions so profound that reality itself folded in on itself when attempting to observe them.
This was the heart ofTHE Loom’sparadoxical domain, and it had grown stronger than ever before.

The concentrated authority here would have unmade any entity belowTHE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyin an instant. Not through violence or destruction, but through the simple impossibility of existing in a space where existence itself was contradicted at every possible angle.
Toward the very depths of this impossible sea, a figure floated with absolute sovereignty.
THE Living Paradox.
His humanoid form could barely be observed through the countless flames of paradox that surrounded him.
What could be glimpsed hinted at immensity beyond comprehension.
He was currently overseeing many things.
The preparations for what was to come. The positioning of pieces across a board that spanned all ofObservable Existence. The final calibrations of mechanisms set in motion eons ago!
Five Seconds to Midnight.

In his perspective, this timing was minuscule. What appeared as seconds to existential observation might as well be actual days or hours from his vantage point. The countdown was real, but it was also relative.
He was getting ready.
And at such a time...
|Haha, Paradox, big guy! It seems like you’re finally getting things ready? Not even a heads up to an old friend? I had to find out from the endless chaos?|
A shocking voice filled with The First Tongue echoed through the sea of paradox. This was a voice that had existed before concepts had names, before reality had settled into its current patterns.
A humanoid figure manifested in the paradoxical depths.

Massive beyond conventional scale, surrounded by murky shadows that devoured light and meaning simultaneously. The shadows writhed with a life of their own, constantly shifting and reforming in patterns that hinted at intelligence. Or perhaps something worse than intelligence.

It was hard to say whether this being was insideTHE Loomor simply chose to manifest within it at this moment while originally existing outside of it entirely. The distinction may not have mattered to something of this nature.
THE Living Paradoxfrowned, his expression visible for just a moment through the flames that surrounded him.
"Chaos," he said in an acknowledgment without welcome. "Why are you here? You still have enough power to do this with your current suppression?"
THE Primordial Chaoslaughed.
The sound was mischievous at first, almost playful in its irreverence. But then it shifted, becoming cold and imposing as it echoed through dimensions that shouldn’t have been able to hold sound.

"Aren’t you curious as to what caused all these changes?" Chaos asked. The murky shadows around him pulsed with each word. "You asked me eons ago in the Infinite Unfurling what had happened between Temporal, THE Creature, and I in that incident in Ginnungagap. That Incident that was the cause of many things. I didn’t tell you then, but I could tell you now since we are about to delve into grander pastures."
The words were heavy and filled with mystery that stretched back to the earliest moments of Existence itself.
ButTHE Living Paradoxremained calm.

"What happened has happened," he replied. His voice was measured despite the weight of the topic. "The past is fixed, even for beings such as ourselves. Knowing history now wouldn’t aid me too much in what I must accomplish. The battle ahead requires focus on the present and future, not excavation of ancient incidents that have already shaped everything they were meant to shape."
THE Primordial Chaoslaughed again.

"That’s where you’re wrong, old friend,"Chaos said. His tone was grand and imposing. "Knowing history even now would especially help, because history and time for some... is malleable. The past you consider fixed? For certain existences, it’s merely another canvas to be painted upon. Another variable to be adjusted. Another paradox to be embraced."
At such words,Paradoxwas silent. Because he also knew this too well!
The flames around his form flickered with something that might have been contemplation.
Moments later, he waved his hand.
Obsidian-gold light coalesced before him, forming an image with perfect clarity despite the contradictory nature of everything surrounding it.

The image showed a figure in flowing robes, a floating crown hovering above his head. His posture wasimperious. His presence radiated authority that challenged the very fabric of reality. Eyes that held depths of power and cunning beyond what any singular existence should possess.
This was how Noah had appeared when he entered the region of collapse. Before he decimated Agents of The Fallout. Before he crushed Schrodinger.
THE Living Paradoxstudied the conjured image with intensity that made the surrounding paradoxical flames burn brighter.

"It is him, isn’t it?" he said. His voice held certainty rather than question."I care not for coincidences, and I locked onto him right away. The moment I sensed the anomalies in the fabric of Existence, I knew something unprecedented was occurring. And all threads led back to this singular being."
Boisterous laughter erupted fromTHE Primordial Chaos.
The murky shadows around him writhed with apparent delight as his massive form shook with mirth that echoed across dimensions.

"Look at you already knowing!" Chaos exclaimed. Genuine amusement colored his words. "Haha, yes. Him. Just like I remember him in Ginnungagap. He slipped right past my fingers then, and I haven’t been able to grab him ever since, even though he’s appeared in the Infinite Unfurling and The Earliest Folds multiple times... as well as existing here in this era."
The laughter faded into something more predatory.
"He is one anomalous fucker," Chaos continued. His voice dropped to something between admiration and hunger. "Man, do I want to get my hands on him."
THE Living Paradox’sfrown deepened.

"Will you play games or be straight with me regarding his anomalous nature?" he asked. His tone held the weight of one supreme being addressing another."I know his history here in this era and have come across him personally. His usage of The First Tongue surprised me when I observed it. Is that the source of his anomalous existence?"
The words hung heavy in the paradoxical waters.
THE Primordial Chaosmoved closer. His murky shadows reached toward the manifested image of Noah as if yearning to touch it.

"In our Existence," Chaos began. His voice took on the weight of primordial truth. "The Oldest Paradox of Existence has always remained unanswered. How did everything begin? In that question, Paradox was claimed as one component. Existence was claimed as another. And Chaos was claimed as well. These three have always been the contenders for the ultimate truth."
He paused, letting the weight of his words settle.

"But now... The First Tongue is being claimed. This glorious fucker of a being here... haha, I won’t say much, but I will say that another competitor of our dearest Observable Existence is just now budding, and he is doing so across time itself!"
The murky shadows pulsed with excitement.
"If one of us were to swallow him up, let’s say... would one not have two components of The Oldest Paradox of Existence? Imagine it... imagine it!"
The words were heavy with implication that stretched across eons and possibilities.
THE Living Paradoxturned fully to look towardTHE Primordial Chaos.

His eyes were visible for just a moment through the paradoxical flames. They showed immense distrust and annoyance. But they also shined with something else. Possibility. Calculation. The recognition of an opportunity.

"You’re trying to fuck with me," Paradox said. His voice was low and dangerous. "Knowing I am at the precipice of my battle with THE Creature, you want me to divide my attention to this anomaly. Do you even know much about him apart from what you have said?"
He gestured dismissively at the manifested image.

"I have much to do against THE Creature. Unless I have every ounce of information at this moment, I won’t move against another specifically. I will wait for the chaos of The Fallout to take care of many things. Because in the aftermath of THE Fallout, even the life of someone at THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty is not guaranteed."
His voice became harder, more resolute.
"At that time, I can move more freely against THE Creature and others. But now... I need focus. Complete, undivided focus on the enemy before me."
THE Primordial Chaos’sexpression became extremely ominous.
The murky shadows around him stopped their constant writhing and became still. A stillness that was somehow more terrifying than their movement had been.
He moved toward the manifested figure of Noah. His massive form cast impossible darkness across the obsidian-gold light.

"Oh... I know him," Chaos said. His voice dropped to something between whisper and thunder. "Chaos whispers his name. Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms whisper his name. Inevitabilities whisper his name. The First Tongue... I have begun to hear whispers of his name in The First Tongue itself."
He reached out, his shadow-wrapped hand passing through the image as if trying to grasp something that existed beyond mere representation.

"The Scale Breaker. THE Anomaly. THE Genesis Monarch. Another variable that makes things even more chaotic. A variable that has been present in Ginnungagap, in The Earliest Folds, in this era, and now... it seems he will also be there after The Fallout."
The ominous expression deepened.
"Oh yes, I know of him. I just came to you to murky the waters even more. To make things even more chaotic."
THE Primordial Chaosbegan to fade, his form dissolving back into the murky shadows from which he’d manifested.
But before he disappeared entirely, his voice echoed one final time.

"Ultimately, it may not be Existence that claims the win of The Oldest Paradox of Existence. It may not be Paradox. It may not be The First Tongue. Just like in the beginning, when everything was formless and uncertain... it may just be Chaos. Just Chaos."
His laughter followed him into oblivion.
"Haha!"
And then he was gone.
THE Living Paradoxgazed at the metaphorical Clock counting to Midnight.

The flames of paradox around him burned with contemplative intensity as he processed everything he’d just learned. With this new information, he might as well turn the clock ever closer toward Midnight. Accelerate his plans. Move against multiple targets simultaneously.
But...
He didn’t like to be reactionary.
Especially when it came to Chaos.

Any choice someone found themselves making after meeting Chaos was likely not their own willing choice. It was more than likely something influenced by Chaos itself, nudged in directions that served Chaos’s unknowable ends.
And Paradox had always done his best not to be steered by Chaos.
Because even now, he stood against an enemy that evenTHE Primordial Chaosdid not go head to head against. He stood againstTHE Creature. And he had to do everything to make sure he didn’t slip.
AgainstTHE Creature, a single slip meant collapse.
But now, learning more aboutTHE Anomaly, about Osmont...

THE Living Paradoxthought more deeply about this being. His intuition had been accurate as always. From the first moment he’d sensed those anomalies in the fabric of Existence, he’d known something unprecedented was occurring.
But for that entity to lay their claim on The First Tongue...
|Interesting. Very interesting.|
The sea of paradox continued to churn around him, contradictions folding into contradictions as the countdown toward Midnight continued its inexorable progression!
