Massive beyond conventional scale, surrounded by murky shadows that devoured light and meaning simultaneously.
The shadows writhed with a life of their own, constantly shifting and reforming in patterns that hinted at intelligence.
Or perhaps something worse than intelligence.
It was hard to say whether this being was insideTHE Loomor simply chose to manifest within it at this moment while originally existing outside of it entirely.
The distinction may not have mattered to something of this nature.
THE Living Paradoxfrowned, his expression visible for just a moment through the flames that surrounded him.
"Chaos," he said in an acknowledgment without welcome.
"Why are you here?
You still have enough power to do this with your current suppression?"
THE Primordial Chaoslaughed.
The sound was mischievous at first, almost playful in its irreverence.
But then it shifted, becoming cold and imposing as it echoed through dimensions that shouldn’t have been able to hold sound.
"Aren’t you curious as to what caused all these changes?" Chaos asked.
The murky shadows around him pulsed with each word.
"You asked me eons ago in the Infinite Unfurling what had happened between Temporal, THE Creature, and I in that incident in Ginnungagap.
That Incident that was the cause of many things.
I didn’t tell you then, but I could tell you now since we are about to delve into grander pastures."
The words were heavy and filled with mystery that stretched back to the earliest moments of Existence itself.
ButTHE Living Paradoxremained calm.
"What happened has happened," he replied.
His voice was measured despite the weight of the topic.
"The past is fixed, even for beings such as ourselves.
Knowing history now wouldn’t aid me too much in what I must accomplish.
The battle ahead requires focus on the present and future, not excavation of ancient incidents that have already shaped everything they were meant to shape."
THE Primordial Chaoslaughed again.
"That’s where you’re wrong, old friend,"Chaos said.
His tone was grand and imposing.
"Knowing history even now would especially help, because history and time for some... is malleable.
The past you consider fixed?
For certain existences, it’s merely another canvas to be painted upon.
Another variable to be adjusted.
Another paradox to be embraced."
At such words,Paradoxwas silent.
Because he also knew this too well!
The flames around his form flickered with something that might have been contemplation.
Moments later, he waved his hand.
Obsidian-gold light coalesced before him, forming an image with perfect clarity despite the contradictory nature of everything surrounding it.
The image showed a figure in flowing robes, a floating crown hovering above his head.
His posture wasimperious.
His presence radiated authority that challenged the very fabric of reality.
Eyes that held depths of power and cunning beyond what any singular existence should possess.
This was how Noah had appeared when he entered the region of collapse.
Before he decimated Agents of The Fallout.
Before he crushed Schrodinger.
THE Living Paradoxstudied the conjured image with intensity that made the surrounding paradoxical flames burn brighter.
"It is him, isn’t it?" he said.
His voice held certainty rather than question."I care not for coincidences, and I locked onto him right away.
The moment I sensed the anomalies in the fabric of Existence, I knew something unprecedented was occurring.
And all threads led back to this singular being."
Boisterous laughter erupted fromTHE Primordial Chaos.
The murky shadows around him writhed with apparent delight as his massive form shook with mirth that echoed across dimensions.
"Look at you already knowing!" Chaos exclaimed.
Genuine amusement colored his words.
"Haha, yes.
Him.
Just like I remember him in Ginnungagap.

He slipped right past my fingers then, and I haven’t been able to grab him ever since, even though he’s appeared in the Infinite Unfurling and The Earliest Folds multiple times... as well as existing here in this era."
The laughter faded into something more predatory.
"He is one anomalous fucker," Chaos continued.
His voice dropped to something between admiration and hunger.
"Man, do I want to get my hands on him."
THE Living Paradox’sfrown deepened.
"Will you play games or be straight with me regarding his anomalous nature?" he asked.
His tone held the weight of one supreme being addressing another."I know his history here in this era and have come across him personally.
His usage of The First Tongue surprised me when I observed it.
Is that the source of his anomalous existence?"
The words hung heavy in the paradoxical waters.
THE Primordial Chaosmoved closer.
His murky shadows reached toward the manifested image of Noah as if yearning to touch it.
"In our Existence," Chaos began.
His voice took on the weight of primordial truth.
"The Oldest Paradox of Existence has always remained unanswered.
How did everything begin?
In that question, Paradox was claimed as one component.
Existence was claimed as another.
And Chaos was claimed as well.
These three have always been the contenders for the ultimate truth."
He paused, letting the weight of his words settle.
"But now...
The First Tongue is being claimed.
This glorious fucker of a being here... haha, I won’t say much, but I will say that another competitor of our dearest Observable Existence is just now budding, and he is doing so across time itself!"
The murky shadows pulsed with excitement.
"If one of us were to swallow him up, let’s say... would one not have two components of The Oldest Paradox of Existence?
Imagine it... imagine it!"
The words were heavy with implication that stretched across eons and possibilities.
THE Living Paradoxturned fully to look towardTHE Primordial Chaos.
His eyes were visible for just a moment through the paradoxical flames.
They showed immense distrust and annoyance.
But they also shined with something else.
Possibility.
Calculation.
The recognition of an opportunity.
"You’re trying to fuck with me," Paradox said.
His voice was low and dangerous.
"Knowing I am at the precipice of my battle with THE Creature, you want me to divide my attention to this anomaly.
Do you even know much about him apart from what you have said?"
He gestured dismissively at the manifested image.
"I have much to do against THE Creature.
Unless I have every ounce of information at this moment, I won’t move against another specifically.
I will wait for the chaos of The Fallout to take care of many things.
Because in the aftermath of THE Fallout, even the life of someone at THE Fundamental Depth of Absolute Sovereignty is not guaranteed."
His voice became harder, more resolute.
"At that time, I can move more freely against THE Creature and others.
But now...
I need focus.
Complete, undivided focus on the enemy before me."
THE Primordial Chaos’sexpression became extremely ominous.
The murky shadows around him stopped their constant writhing and became still.
A stillness that was somehow more terrifying than their movement had been.
He moved toward the manifested figure of Noah.
His massive form cast impossible darkness across the obsidian-gold light.
I know him," Chaos said.
His voice dropped to something between whisper and thunder.
"Chaos whispers his name.
Malformed Ginnu Lifeforms whisper his name.
Inevitabilities whisper his name.
The First Tongue...
I have begun to hear whispers of his name in The First Tongue itself."
He reached out, his shadow-wrapped hand passing through the image as if trying to grasp something that existed beyond mere representation.
"The Scale Breaker.
THE Anomaly.
THE Genesis Monarch.
Another variable that makes things even more chaotic.
A variable that has been present in Ginnungagap, in The Earliest Folds, in this era, and now... it seems he will also be there after The Fallout."
The ominous expression deepened.
"Oh yes, I know of him.
I just came to you to murky the waters even more.
To make things even more chaotic."
THE Primordial Chaosbegan to fade, his form dissolving back into the murky shadows from which he’d manifested.
But before he disappeared entirely, his voice echoed one final time.
"Ultimately, it may not be Existence that claims the win of The Oldest Paradox of Existence.
It may not be Paradox.
It may not be The First Tongue.
Just like in the beginning, when everything was formless and uncertain... it may just be Chaos.
Just Chaos."
His laughter followed him into oblivion.
"Haha!"
And then he was gone.
THE Living Paradoxgazed at the metaphorical Clock counting to Midnight.
The flames of paradox around him burned with contemplative intensity as he processed everything he’d just learned.
With this new information, he might as well turn the clock ever closer toward Midnight.
Accelerate his plans.
Move against multiple targets simultaneously.
But...
He didn’t like to be reactionary.
Especially when it came to Chaos.
Any choice someone found themselves making after meeting Chaos was likely not their own willing choice.
It was more than likely something influenced by Chaos itself, nudged in directions that served Chaos’s unknowable ends.
And Paradox had always done his best not to be steered by Chaos.
Because even now, he stood against an enemy that evenTHE Primordial Chaosdid not go head to head against.
He stood againstTHE Creature.
And he had to do everything to make sure he didn’t slip.
AgainstTHE Creature, a single slip meant collapse.
But now, learning more aboutTHE Anomaly, about Osmont...
THE Living Paradoxthought more deeply about this being.
His intuition had been accurate as always.
From the first moment he’d sensed those anomalies in the fabric of Existence, he’d known something unprecedented was occurring.
But for that entity to lay their claim on The First Tongue...
|Interesting.
Very interesting.|
The sea of paradox continued to churn around him, contradictions folding into contradictions as the countdown toward Midnight continued its inexorable progression!

chapters.title: Chapter 4657: Perfect Speaker!
paragraphs: He had been a Hunter, he had been a Farmer, he had been a Hero and a Villain. He had become a King and an Emperor and much more.
But a Teacher... a Teacher was something very unique for Noah.
At this moment, in The Early Veiled Shore, he sat on his Abode while teaching on The First Tongue.

THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsfluttered page to page within its first 18 Chapters that represented the 18 Phonemes of The First Tongue. He’d already gone through every single one to his people, explaining the intricacies and foundations.
At this moment, these Phonemes floated in the air to be visible to all as the skies of the Early Veiled Shore were filled with waves of blue-gold Primus Mana.
THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsremained open as Noah looked at his people.
Many were either standing or seated on the golden sands as they looked at him with a myriad of different gazes.

Some like Tor, THE Living Origin, Sigrid, Riya, Kael, and Malphas had shining eyes. Tor and THE Living Origin clearly knew what he talked about already, their expressions those of beings who’d spent eons with The First Tongue woven into their very existence.
Sigrid, Riya, Kael, and Malphas had different levels of understanding, but their eyes showed comprehension was taking root. Seeds being planted that would grow into something magnificent.

Others like Henry, Moiraine, Barbatos, and Adelaide looked toward him with a sense of confusion. Their expressions betrayed the reality that they hadn’t truly gotten much from his explanations. The concepts were too vast, too alien to their foundations of understanding.

Then there were others like Titano and The Emperor Penguin whose eyes were dull as if they understood absolutely nothing at all. Completely blank. As if Noah had been speaking in a language that didn’t exist.
Noah looked at all of them and shook his head.
His gaze settled on his Son.
Henry Osmont.
|Boy, step forward.|
HUUM!
Henry was astonished by the way he was called as he dazedly floated up from his seated position on the golden sands. His expression held confusion and a hint of wariness as he approached his father.
Noah looked at him. His son was the one who carried his lineage the most. The blood that flowed through Henry’s veins held potential that most entities in Observable Existence would never comprehend.
And Noah now allowed it to express itself freely.

His Lineage ofTHE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexiconsbegan to exert its effects right now as he allowed the Greater Distinction for Entangled Weavings to spread wide and free.The Greater Distinction of THE Potentate!

Around Henry, invisible chains of limitation began to loosen. The Greater Distinction granted him a 5,000,000% increase in learning speed for any Mana-based abilities. It granted him the potential to comprehend and utilize The First Tongue itself.
A deep connection to Mana that allowed instinctive understanding of its nature began to awaken within him. And near Noah, his advancement speed increased by an additional 800%.
His son had a 5 Million percent boon in learning speed, and another 800% when cultivating near him.
Could he really not form a mere Phoneme of Fire with all this?
Just thinking about it made Noah slightly angry.
He waved his hand.
The Goad manifested in his grip. The stick shined with blue-gold brilliance and came with a terrifying pressure ofTHE Surface Depth.
Noah had this immensity and weight even though he wasn’t officially at this stage. His Existential Weight already exceeded what it should be, and now that pressure bore down on everyone present.
The weight was heavy on all those here as Henry paled, looking at his father as if he wanted to ask... Dude, what the hell is going on?!
But Noah remained stern.
"Write the Phoneme of Fire."
Henry Osmont looked at his father. He saw the immense seriousness in his eyes and the stick within his hands.
With all these factors, he didn’t even argue as he raised his hand burning with blue mana, remembered what his father had taught, and began to write.
He began to shape mana into structure as his father had taught him.

And as he did, due to The First Tongue being utilized to form the Phoneme of Fire, the surroundings began to respond. The Principle of Elemental Fury, The Principle of Rapid Fire, and other Principles related to fire in the surroundings inherently began to flow toward the letter Henry was forging.
The rising frequency of Mana.
The simultaneous expression.
The sharp percussive accent.
The controlled explosion outward.
These were the conditions one had to meet to successfully write the letter of fire. The Phoneme of Fire.
Yet... his sonfailedat matching the rising frequency alone.

Noah saw exactly where he failed. After all, he had many Phonemes of Fire and Logos made up of many letters constantly refining his existence and running across his very cells and vessels. He knew the Phonemes like the back of his hands.

At this moment, Noah took his stick and stopped the Phoneme his son was constructing before it erupted and destroyed everything. The malformed letter of fire trembled and then dissipated under the touch of The Goad, its volatile energy dispersing harmlessly into the atmosphere.

Around Noah’s body,THE Genesis Principle of Undifferentiated Mana... THE Philology of Undifferentiated Manashined brilliantly. He radiated a unique air as he began to correct his son. An air of absolute mastery over the very language of existence itself!
Noah was currently moving with instinct alone as he said, "You got the frequency wrong. The rise needs to be steeper at the initiation point, then plateau briefly before the final surge. Like this."
He demonstrated with a casual wave of his hand, and a perfect frequency pattern of blue-gold Mana rippled outward.
"Do it again."
Henry focused and did it again.
The rising frequency of Mana. The simultaneous expression. The sharp percussive accent. The controlled explosion outward.
He failed at the simultaneous expression. The elements that should have moved as one instead staggered, creating dissonance in the forming Phoneme.
Noah stepped in once more, his voice calm but firm.

"The simultaneous expression isn’t about forcing everything to happen at once. It’s about creating harmony between the components so they naturally align. You’re trying to control each element separately. Don’t. Let them breathe together. The frequency, the accent, the explosion, they’re not four things. They’re one thing expressing itself in four ways."
|THE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons is teaching his progeny.|
|All features of your Way and Pedagogical Amplification have activated at full capacity.|
|Current Teaching Mode: Active Guidance.|
|Harvest Multiplier: +500%.|
Such a prompt shined as Henry tried again.
And failed.
Noah corrected the mistake. "Your accent was too sharp. Fire is explosive, yes, but it’s not violent. It’s passionate. There’s a difference."
Henry tried again.
And failed.
"The explosion outward was uncontrolled. You released everything at once instead of directing the expansion. Fire spreads, it doesn’t scatter."
Again.
Failure.
"Better on the frequency. Worse on the expression. Focus!"
Again.
Again.
Again!

Noah corrected every mistake with patience that surprised even himself. Each failure was met not with disappointment but with precise instruction. Each attempt brought Henry closer to understanding not just the mechanics of the Phoneme, but its fundamental nature.
And then.
The rising frequency bloomed perfectly, steep at initiation, plateauing, then surging.
The simultaneous expression harmonized, four aspects becoming one unified whole.
The sharp percussive accent struck with passion rather than violence.
The controlled explosion expanded outward with directed purpose.
Under the guidance of his father holding a stick that seemed like it wouldbeathim if he got it wrong again, Henry watched in a daze as a Phoneme of Fire bloomed successfully in front of him.

The power of multiple Grand and Singularity Principles related to fire were pulled into it. A beautiful pillar of blue-gold flames that would decimate a weak Pre-THE actually bloomed and spun upward gorgeously!
The heat was immense yet somehow welcoming. The light was blinding yet somehow soothing. The authority was undeniable yet somehow...his.
Henry’s eyes went wide with disbelief as he stared at what he’d created.
Far on the golden sands of the Shore,THE First Hunger, Tor,stood with a look of utter incredulity as he shouted out.
"What the fuck?!"

Not too far away,THE Living Originhad a similar gaze of incredulity. Her ancient eyes were wide with something approaching shock. This... this was not accurately portraying how impossible it was for someone to learn The First Tongue.
Much less that someone being an entity who had not attained anyDepth of Absolute Sovereignty!
The First Tongue was the language of Existence itself. Beings spent eons attempting to grasp even a single Phoneme.

THE Living Existenceshad taken countless ages to master what they knew. And here, a boy who hadn’t even reached the heights of power that should be prerequisite for such comprehension had just successfully written a Phoneme of Fire.
In the skies, Noah looked at his son and smiled brilliantly.
"Good," he said. "Now repeat that again, and make sure you don’t get it wrong. Afterwards, you can practice the other Phonemes."
HUUM!
Blue-gold light erupted around father and son, brilliant and warm and filled with the authority of something unprecedented occurring.
Noah saw the emergence of glorious prompts.
|Successful Teaching of The First Tongue to Another Entity Confirmed.|
|Harvest Multiplier: +1,200%.|
|Harvest in the form of Infinite Potential has been automatically absorbed into your Mastery of The First Tongue.|
|Breakthrough Achieved.|
|As of this moment, you have attained the Mastery of Perfect Speaker.|
|The act of teaching was the final ingredient required for this advancement since you can already seamlessly enact Philologies. Grander stages await.|
|Even with your stupendous foundation,THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntycan officially be grasped at any time.|
|Note: Your current Existential Weight already exceeds most averageTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentities.|
|Going past the Mastery of Perfect Speaker may need an official declaration of your Way and Civilization.|
Noah looked at the prompts with calm satisfaction.
The Mastery of Perfect Speaker!
And all it had taken was teaching his son to write a single letter.
But the last prompt...he looked at it calmly as he thought of his ideas regardings Foundations andTHE.
He... may have to alter his plans somewhat. After all, he was not obsessive when it came to one line of though!
A declaration of His Way.
An Indomitable and unsurpassable Foundation.
It did not have to be either or as...his Foundation would never be complete!
Even as aTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyentity officially, he would still be forging his Foundation!
As his thoughts became slightly clear, he nodded to himself and finalized a decision.

He looked at Henry, who was staring at the Phoneme of Fire he’d created with an expression of wonder and disbelief. His son had just accomplished something that should have been impossible for someone at his level.
But then again, Noah thought with a slight smile, impossible was starting to become a rather flexible concept when it came to his bloodline.
On the golden sands below,Torwas still staring upward with his mouth hanging open.
"Boy," Noah said, looking at his son."I will move on to others, but continue. Go again."
Henry Osmont looked at his father, then at the stick still held casually in his grip, then back at his father.
He swallowed hard.
"Yes, Father."

On the golden sands below,Torwas still staring upward with his mouth hanging open.
"Boy," Noah said, looking at his son."I will move on to others, but continue.
Go again."
Henry Osmont looked at his father, then at the stick still held casually in his grip, then back at his father.
He swallowed hard.
"Yes, Father."

chapters.title: Chapter 4658: Scales I
paragraphs: Sometimes, Noah found it easier not to question.
If things seemed ridiculously crazy to be happening, it didn’t necessarily mean they were impossible. It simply meant that the vast majority of Existence considered it impossible.
What he enjoyed doing was redefining what was possible and what was not possible.

It was nearly impossible for someone that hadn’t achieved at leastTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyto utilize The First Tongue since many had specialized into different Ways. If some did try, it would take them a long time.
He gave a middle finger to all those assertions as he proceeded to teach his son in a matter of minutes what others would deem impossible in even years.
And after he did this, even though he saw the expressions ofTHE First Hunger and THE Living Origin,he didn’t stop to question or think about it too much.
He simply pointed to others with his stick as he called out.
"Sigrid, Moiraine, Riya, Barbatos, Emperor Penguin, Hyperion, Queen of Matter, Night, Titano, Erickson... you, you, you, you!"

He pointed the stick to dozens of beings who could have his Greater Distinction of his Lineage. One by one, all of those appointed rose up as their expressions showed the surreal reality they were experiencing.
And as soon as they floated in the skies, Noah looked at them like a stern teacher holding a stick that would discipline if he needed to.
"Write the Phoneme of Fire for me."
HUUM!

His body emanated waves of immensity and power that almost made his words undeniable. Innately, all of those that he called up began trying to write the Phoneme of Fire. Every time one messed up, his Goad struck out and stopped any horrific explosion as he corrected them one after another.

He could move faster than Planck Speed as he watched all of them as if they were moving in slow motion. He corrected them all one by one even though it seemed like he was doing everything simultaneously.
To Sigrid: "Your frequency is perfect but your accent needs more passion. Fire loves, it doesn’t just burn."
To Moiraine: "Stop overthinking. The paradox in your nature is fighting the purity of fire. Let them coexist."
To Riya: "You’re seeing the future of the Phoneme before you’ve written the present. Focus on now."
To the Emperor Penguin: "...Just...just try again."
To Titano: "...Brother, come on."
To Erikson: " ...I can pull out the Slipper if you need more motivation."
|An unprecedented lesson on The First Tongue is unfolding.|
|All progression has become accelerated under your direct guidance.|
|The weight and immensity of your existence increases as you naturally harvest Infinite Potential from your current actions.|
|Multiple instances of Pedagogical Amplification are stacking.|
|Current Harvest Multiplier: Calculating...|
Noah looked at all of these prompts. Even though they seemed grand and his current actions seemed grand, he felt like he could do so much more.
And so he simply proceeded to do.

At this moment where one body floated in the skies and was teaching dozens of his people with direct attention, another body of his appeared in front of Khor,Tor, andTHE Living Originwho came over from nearby.
Khor looked at him with those obsidian-crimson eyes blazing.
"You’re nuts, Outsider. Nuts!"
But as soon as she said these words, her eyes burned with competitive spirit as she began trying to etch the Phoneme of Fire right away.
Noah’s body here gave a portion of his attention to her, getting ready to correct her at any time as he also turned to look atTHE First Hunger and THE Living Origin.

They looked at him asTHE First Hungerblinked and harrumphed before he proceeded to say, "I can write the Phonemes of The First Tongue! I learned it in Ginnungagap from THE Primeval Titan, both me and this crazy woman did."
He said these words as Noah nodded before he said, "Okay, you know Phonemes. What about Logos? Philology?"
His eyes were shining brilliantly at this moment.
Because he knew there was a ridiculous 3,000,000% harvest if he could get anyone to grasp a Genesis-level teaching. If he could get anyone to perfectly understand a Philology of Existence.

Basically, he needed to get someone to grasp a new Genesis Principle. Or in the case of entities that had already attained a Depth of Absolute Sovereignty and had already grasped a Genesis Principle without knowing that they were actually accessing a Philology of The First Tongue... he could show them the Way.
So he looked with shining eyes at the figures ofTHE First Hunger and THE Living Originwho were looking back at him with gazes that still seemed to ask if he was serious.

Even though they didn’t mention it, the two of them still inherently had a sense of pride in their own power. But those who understood themselves could easily get past any shortcomings. They became serious right after.
Tor said,"I need more practice on Logos. I was collapsed just when I was getting good at them."
AndTHE Living Originlooked at Noah with extremely calm yet shining golden eyes before she said, "I can see if you know more than me in Philology."
HUUM!
Right.

THE Living Originhad enjoyed boons fromTHE Prison of THE Creaturebefore she was collapsed byTHE Living Paradox. She had lived for much longer thanTHE First Hungeras her gains should have been more immense. Even if she was returned right now at onlyTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
Noah smiled brilliantly at this.
Would another person that didn’t have The Way of The First Tongue claim that they could speak The First Tongue better than he could?
IfTHE Living Originthought that she could speak Philology better than he could, or be faster at it, then he would have her learn.
This in itself was a daring thought. Not too long ago, he and many others only thought ofTHE Living Originas a legend to be looked at. Now he was looking at her and daring to teach her.
It was a surreal experience!

chapters.title: Chapter 4659: Scales II
paragraphs: At this moment, before they could even begin...
HUUM!
They raised their heads.

Far above, where his other body was, Sigrid’s black and white hair shined radiantly as white and blue flames surged upward like a brilliant, gorgeous pillar of light. She was another that succeeded in forming the Phoneme of Fire.
THE Living Orderhad grasped fire, and her full entry intoTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntychurned ever closer!
Something that was deemed unfathomably rare by others... Noah’s eyes pulsed dangerously as he wanted to make such a rare thingcommonplacefor his Civilization.
His other body, feeling the golden sands of the Early Veiled Shore below him, turned back towardTHE First Hunger and THE Living Origin.
"Let’s get started."
He was moving with efficiency and not necessarily with speed and haste, but he was doing many things at this moment.
Far from the Early Veiled Shore, in what could be considered the core of The Infiniverse itself, where a tremendous amount of authority gathered.

The region was one of extremely dense and pure concentrated Primus Mana shining blue-gold. Countless stellar rivers of lemniscate symbols and Mobius strips spun all around in eternal patterns. And at this moment, Phonemes of The First Tongue were also beginning to permeate and spread around this region with immensity. All of them were actually being forged by The Infiniverse herself.

At the center of this place, where vibrant Logos could be seen being formed, the figures of Noah, The Infiniverse, and even the illusory Ruination floated in this terrifyingly dense sea of authority. They were actually the source of the increased weight and immensity as time passed.
At this moment, the figure of The Infiniverse opened her eyes and looked toward her master.
"Will Master proceed to do it?"
Would he do it.
Noah smiled at the question as he felt his existence.
His Foundation. His Organ. His Weight.

Everything about him held the immensity ofTHE. He simply hadn’t made it official as he wanted to see how far he could match theDepths of Absolute Sovereigntywithout having stepped into this stage himself. But...
"The Depths of Absolute Sovereignty are also a power. And I can continue refining my foundation even while gaining deeper and deeper Depths..."
He looked at The Infiniverse and Ruination with calm certainty.

"Alongside my Lineage, my Foundation, my Organ, and everything else about me reaching my Way, I will officially take my Way of Mana and Hunger to THE. THE Primordial Civilization of Mana. THE Primordial Civilization of Hunger."
His voice grew stronger, more resolute.

"And with THE Way of Mana... would it also not be THE Way of The First Tongue? The First Tongue is Mana given structure. Mana given meaning. Mana given voice. They are not separate things. They are the same thing wearing different faces."
HUUM!
"So let it all fall into place before The Fallout. Let everything I have built and everything I have become consolidate into what it was always meant to be."
Some people took eons to attainTHE. Some were born atTHEwhen Existence differentiated. ButTHEwas a struggle. AttainingTHEwas hard.
But at this time...
"I have Mana. I am Mana."
HUUM!
"I have Infinite Mana. I am... Infinite Mana."
WAA!
"And as of this moment, it shall be THE Infinite Mana. It shall be THE Way of Mana. It shall be MY Way of Mana. MY Way of THE First Tongue. MY First Tongue."
HUUM!
Unfathomable brilliance bloomed.
The color blue-gold erupted and spread out across this domain. Past the Early Veiled Shore. Across The Infiniverse.
Outside The Infiniverse into the Wandering Territories. And into the Lands of the Living and the Dead.
A blue-gold light representing the assertion of a unique authority established itself across Existence!
It was an unfathomable light of brilliance!
It was a choice.
And with every choice, there came other choices. With every action, there was an equal and opposite reaction.
At this same time as a declaration was made across Existence.
Inside ofTHE Loom, in that endless sea of Paradox.
THE Living Paradoxsensed the unknown changes across Existence. His form, barely visible through the countless flames of paradox that surrounded him, went still.
He could sense these changes. He could feel how they caused Chaos, Existence, and Paradox itself to resonate and shift.
Something had just been claimed. Something had just been declared.
And the ripples of that declaration were spreading faster than light, faster than thought, faster than causality itself.
The balance had shifted.
And as a result of this...
THE Living Paradoxraised his hand with calm certainty. His voice was measured, ancient, absolute.
"There is... no more time for waiting. No more time for preparation.
HUUM!
He snapped his fingers.
The metaphorical clock that counted toward Midnight trembled. The hand that had been pointing at Five Seconds lurched forward.
Past Four.
Past Three.
Past Two.
THE Living Paradoxbreathed out as if he was getting ready.
"It is now... One Second to Midnight."
BOOM!
The sea of Paradox churned with anticipation of what was to come.
Outside ofTHE Loom.
In that region of Collapse where Noah had locked Schrodinger and The Disciple ofTHE Creature.
He floated calmly in the blue-gold brilliance as he looked at the manifestation of a clock that had been Five Seconds to Midnight.
And in the next moment, he watched the hand of the clock moving.
From Five.
To Four.
To Three.
To Two.
Until it reached One.
Until there was just a sliver to Midnight.
One Second to Midnight.
Noahgazed at this calmly.
He knew his immensity. One of the reasons he’d held back fromTHEwas this. But he was not fearful.
The Fallout? Okay.
Let it fucking come.
THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereigntywould only be one of his tools.THE First Tonguewas his main tool. His Mana was his tool.
And it was mighty.
It was sharp.
And it was hungry for blood!

chapters.title: Chapter 4660: THE! I
paragraphs: In that centermost region of The Infiniverse, in that brilliant blue-gold sea filled with Phonemes and Logos of The First Tongue.
Noah pulsed with an incandescent blue-gold light ofTHE Civilizational Authority.
But he wasn’t alone in this.
So did The Infiniverse. So did Ruination.
After all, his Civilization was intricately connected to them.
The Infiniverse was the literal bedrock. The thing holding his Civilization. His entrance intoTHEwas her entrance intoTHE. She was becomingTHE Infiniverse.
Ruination was intricately fused with him and his system. She felt like an unbreakable part of him, and she would enjoy and be elevated all around just like him.
This was his Way. His Civilization. His immensity!
He had already been in the state ofTHEwith his weight. Now, it felt like the eruption of all his potential.
Of his foundation.
|A Higher Scale of Existence is being grasped officially.|
|Your existence is attaining THE Level One Scale of Existence.|
|Transition initiating...|
In that unique space where he stood with Ruination and The Infiniverse, his eyes shone brightly as he sensed everything.
THE Level One Scale of Existence.

This whole time, he had been in The Level Zero Scale of Existence. And he had managed to do grand things within it.He had suppressed THEs in this lower scale. He had done things THEs couldn’t do in this lower scale.
The potential for what he could do at a Higher Scale was unfathomably grand.
The transition was not violent or painful.
It was... clarifying.

Like someone had been looking at existence through a foggy window their entire life, and now that window had been cleaned for the first time. Well, no. Not cleaned. Removed entirely. He wasn’t looking through anything anymore. He was simply seeing!
Oh!
The waves and strings that made up existence became even more clear to him now. Before, he had glimpsed them. Understood them intellectually. Felt their presence when he focused.
Now they were simply there. Constantly visible, constantly tangible, and constantly real.

He could move faster than Planck Speed. And at this scale, he could see the countless minute strings that made up existence. Strings as small as Planck Length vibrated with frequencies that held the secrets of reality itself. Each string sang its own song. Each vibration told its own story.
And he could hear them all.

The Phonemes of The First Tongue held their own waves. Their own vibrations. The Weavings of The First Tongue connecting them all had their own signatures. Like fingerprints made of pure meaning. Like DNA composed of primordial truth.
He could feel more intricately how Fire burned.

When he looked at this Phoneme now, he could instantly sense all of its 81 Variations. Each variation was a different aspect of fire. A different truth about transformation and a different expression of energy released.
As a Perfect Speaker of The First Tongue who now grasped a Depth, this seemed only natural.

This was why it was easier forTHEentities to grasp The First Tongue even though they didn’t follow The Way of Mana. Even though they specialized, their Ways were different dialects of The First Tongue. They could form that connection with it once they could more easily see the intricacy of existence atTHE Level One Scale of Existence.
Everything made more sense now.
Everything felt more real!
|Confirmation: You have laid an absolute claim over The First Tongue.|

|Perpetual Harvest and The Cheating Architect shine with glory. At this moment, you are gaining 100% of the Harvest in the form of Infinite Potential of all Mana being utilized across Observable Existence.|
|As the true form of Mana, the claim laid on The First Tongue will also generate benefit.|
|All utilization of The First Tongue in your Observable Existence will reinforce and refine your existence in the form of Infinite Potential.|
|There is Utilization of The First Tongue in The Past, The Present, and The Future.|
|At your current stage, 1% of the utilization of The First Tongue in the past and present is being harvested as Infinite Potential.|
|You are unable to harvest from the future.|
|The Infinite Potential floods into your Foundation and your Civilization.|
|Your Depth is becoming more quintessential.|
Noah’s eyes pulsed with immensity as he felt an influx of endless waves of potential.
His Civilization was advancing, and it was doing so with immense grandness.

Without even closing his eyes, he felt his Walls of Civilization surrounding his Manifested Civilization in his mind transforming. The structures that had protected his Civilization since its inception were evolving into something far grander. Something befittingTHE!
|The Walls of Your Civilization have becomeTHE Bastions of Infinity.|
|The Designation of Your Civilization has jumped past the Third Designation to arrive in theFourth Designation: THE Civilization Continuum.|
|THE Bastions of Infinity have begun to be passively manifested across The Infiniverse.|
|Capability: Inherently manifesting 100 Logos of Defensive Architecture per hour.|
|Your Civilization is now at THE Level One Scale of Existence.|
|Changes have only just begun to unfold.|
|The masses of your Civilization will experience unknown and grand changes in the near future.|
Noah feltTHE Infiniversepulsing as everything around them became more concentrated.

This entire area he was in was now filled withTHE Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger. Hundreds of Phonemes and their variations bloomed every second. Fire. Water. Earth. Air. Light. Darkness. Time. Space. All eighteen base Phonemes and their countless variations manifested and dissolved and manifested again in an endless cycle!
THE Infiniversewas breathing The First Tongue!
Fucking breathing it!
Oh!
And even as these changes took place, his own existence was receiving immense seas of Infinite Potential. Even though he had just attainedTHE...
|Your Foundation has taken in an unfathomable amount of Infinite Potential.|
|Eruption of immensity detected.|
|The weight of your existence is now exceeding THE Surface Depth.|
|Spillover into Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty confirmed.|
|Status Update: While your Way is at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, the Weight of Your Existence is at Intermediate Depth.|
|THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons expands its Chapters and Pages with your brilliance.|

Removed entirely.
He wasn’t looking through anything anymore.
He was simply seeing!
Oh!
The waves and strings that made up existence became even more clear to him now.
Before, he had glimpsed them.
Understood them intellectually.
Felt their presence when he focused.
Now they were simply there.
Constantly visible, constantly tangible, and constantly real.
He could move faster than Planck Speed.
And at this scale, he could see the countless minute strings that made up existence.
Strings as small as Planck Length vibrated with frequencies that held the secrets of reality itself.
Each string sang its own song.
Each vibration told its own story.
And he could hear them all.
The Phonemes of The First Tongue held their own waves.
Their own vibrations.
The Weavings of The First Tongue connecting them all had their own signatures.
Like fingerprints made of pure meaning.
Like DNA composed of primordial truth.
He could feel more intricately how Fire burned.
When he looked at this Phoneme now, he could instantly sense all of its 81 Variations.
Each variation was a different aspect of fire.
A different truth about transformation and a different expression of energy released.
As a Perfect Speaker of The First Tongue who now grasped a Depth, this seemed only natural.
This was why it was easier forTHEentities to grasp The First Tongue even though they didn’t follow The Way of Mana.
Even though they specialized, their Ways were different dialects of The First Tongue.
They could form that connection with it once they could more easily see the intricacy of existence atTHE Level One Scale of Existence.
Everything made more sense now.
Everything felt more real!
|Confirmation: You have laid an absolute claim over The First Tongue.|
|Perpetual Harvest and The Cheating Architect shine with glory.
At this moment, you are gaining 100% of the Harvest in the form of Infinite Potential of all Mana being utilized across Observable Existence.|
|As the true form of Mana, the claim laid on The First Tongue will also generate benefit.|
|All utilization of The First Tongue in your Observable Existence will reinforce and refine your existence in the form of Infinite Potential.|
|There is Utilization of The First Tongue in The Past, The Present, and The Future.|
|At your current stage, 1% of the utilization of The First Tongue in the past and present is being harvested as Infinite Potential.|
|You are unable to harvest from the future.|
|The Infinite Potential floods into your Foundation and your Civilization.|
|Your Depth is becoming more quintessential.|
Noah’s eyes pulsed with immensity as he felt an influx of endless waves of potential.
His Civilization was advancing, and it was doing so with immense grandness.
Without even closing his eyes, he felt his Walls of Civilization surrounding his Manifested Civilization in his mind transforming.
The structures that had protected his Civilization since its inception were evolving into something far grander.
Something befittingTHE!
|The Walls of Your Civilization have becomeTHE Bastions of Infinity.|
|The Designation of Your Civilization has jumped past the Third Designation to arrive in theFourth Designation: THE Civilization Continuum.|
|THE Bastions of Infinity have begun to be passively manifested across The Infiniverse.|
|Capability: Inherently manifesting 100 Logos of Defensive Architecture per hour.|
|Your Civilization is now at THE Level One Scale of Existence.|
|Changes have only just begun to unfold.|
|The masses of your Civilization will experience unknown and grand changes in the near future.|
Noah feltTHE Infiniversepulsing as everything around them became more concentrated.
This entire area he was in was now filled withTHE Civilizational Authority of Mana and Hunger.
Hundreds of Phonemes and their variations bloomed every second.
Fire.
Water.
Earth.
Air.
Light.
Darkness.
Time.
Space.
All eighteen base Phonemes and their countless variations manifested and dissolved and manifested again in an endless cycle!
THE Infiniversewas breathing The First Tongue!
Fucking breathing it!
Oh!
And even as these changes took place, his own existence was receiving immense seas of Infinite Potential.
Even though he had just attainedTHE...
|Your Foundation has taken in an unfathomable amount of Infinite Potential.|
|Eruption of immensity detected.|
|The weight of your existence is now exceeding THE Surface Depth.|
|Spillover into Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereignty confirmed.|
|Status Update: While your Way is at THE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty, the Weight of Your Existence is at Intermediate Depth.|
|THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons expands its Chapters and Pages with your brilliance.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4661: THE! II
paragraphs: Noah feltTHE Organ of Civilization and THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexiconsin his mind pulsing with immensity. They were drawing in tremendous waves of potential endlessly. Like twin hearts pumping not blood but pure possibility through the veins of his existence.

Across his veins and vessels and Heart of Infinite Lexicons, rivers of Phonemes and Logos had now begun to flow and refine his existence passively. He could feel them coursing through him. Fire warming his meridians. Water cooling his consciousness. Earth stabilizing his foundation. Air lightening his spirit.
All of it flowing and all of it refining. All of it making him more!
And regardless of apocalypses, struggles, unfairness... the one thing he alwayslovedacross existence was exactly this.
The sense of advancement.
The sense of finding out something new.
The sense of unmasking the wonders of existence.

Even putting aside all the messy aspects of existence and all the terrifying beings out there, the sheer fact that he, a nobody, now laid claim to one of the aspects ofThe Oldest Paradox of Existence... that alone was enough to cause him to reflect with amazement.

He had started as a human. A regular human in a world that had been invaded by dungeons and monsters. He had clawed his way up through blood and pain and impossible choices. He had become a King. An Emperor. A being that shook Folds.
And now he had laid claim to The First Tongue itself.
Yes, existence could suck sometimes.
But it held so many wonders that he wanted to continue exploring. It held so many limits he wanted to overcome that he didn’t want it to end.
The Fallout would not end this.
THE Living Paradox or THE Creature or THE Primordial Chaos would not end his path.
He would ensure it.
After all, he had just laid claim toTHE First Tongueitself. He had laid a claim onTHE Infinite Manaon the eve of a terrifyingApocalypse.
Surviving The Fallout would merely be the first step. He was genuinely curious whatTHE Living Paradox and THE Creaturehad in store.
And of course,THE Living Elemental, that bum of an existence, that waste of elements, his sworn enemy across existence, would also be free fromTHE Loom.
He smiled as he thought of this.
And more prompts came.
|Notification: The Edicts of Your Civilization are being edited to match your current Way.|
|All subsidiary structures must evolve according to your Way after it has attainedTHE.|
|The Sovereign Spires of Osmont have completed their journey.|
|Final Stage Achieved:THE Stanchions of Infinity.|
|THE Stanchions of Infinity are conceptual pillars of support within your existence.|
|They reinforce your Foundation, stabilize your Civilization, and anchor your Way to Observable Existence itself.|
|Features of THE Stanchions of Infinity:|
|Feature One: Civilization Specialization Unlock. The Stanchions unlock additional Civilization Specializations for your people.|

|Feature Two: Passive Phoneme Production. Each Stanchion acts as a passive producer of Phonemes of The First Tongue within your existence. Production Rate: 3 Phonemes per Stanchion per hour currently, will scale upwards.|
|Feature Three: External Manifestation Capability.THE Stanchions of Infinity can be outwardly manifested to establish THE Existential Faraday Cage.|
|THE Existential Faraday Cage:|
|159 THE Stanchions of Infinity can be placed around The Infiniverse to block external Weavings of Existence.|
|All components of existence are composed of waves and strings at their most fundamental level.|
|THE Existential Faraday Cage is a barrier designed to absorb external attacks that come as forms of waves and strings.|

|Energy attacks, authority suppression, conceptual assaults, temporal manipulation, spatial distortion, and even attacks composed of The First Tongue itself will be absorbed by the Cage rather than penetrating to the interior.|
|Absorption Capacity: Dependent on the combined strength of all 159 Stanchions.|
Noah observed internally as these Stanchions manifested within his existence.
THE Quintessential Stanchion of Infinity shined with a colorless grandeur. It looked like some sort of infinitely stretching tower that had no end. Just eternal vertical expanse.
THE Tyranny Stanchion of Infinity shined stellar purple. Its surface crackled with authority that demanded submission from all who perceived it.
THE Loot Stanchion of Infinity gleamed with pure gold. Wealth and harvest radiated from it in waves that promised endless accumulation.
And many more!

All 159 were lit up brilliantly. They looked like pillars supporting his Foundation even more securely than before. Each one unique. Each one powerful. Each one a testament to how far his Civilization had come.
He broke down the capabilities of THE Stanchions of Infinity in his mind.

Passive Phoneme production meant his mastery of The First Tongue would continue growing even when he wasn’t actively cultivating. 159 Stanchions producing 3 Phonemes per hour each. That was 477 Phonemes per hour flooding into his existence automatically.
The Civilization Specializations would give his people more paths to power. More ways to grow. More options for surviving what was coming.
But the Faraday Cage...
That was the real prize.

A barrier that could absorb attacks composed of waves and strings. And since all components of existence were waves and strings at their most fundamental level, that meant the barrier could absorbessentially anything.
Energy. Authority. Concepts. Time. Space. Even The First Tongue.
Everything.

Noah thought about this paired with the Logos and Phonemes that he and The Infiniverse were forging outside the barrier of The Infiniverse. Defensive Architecture being passively manifested. Hundreds of Phonemes blooming. THE Bastions of Infinity producing 100 Logos of Defensive Architecture per hour.
Would it all not be more than enough for survival against The Fallout?
He smiled at the thought. As he was thinking this...
In the next moment, another set of prompts cascaded down.
But...
HUUM!
They came from the surrounding existence. From the glimmer ofTHE Civilizational AuthorityNoah could now see across existence. They didn’t simply come as a prompt.
Noah heard...a voice.
And it was a heavy and deep voice that held unfathomable majesty.
This voice said...
|Welcome, you have arrived truly and finally in THE Vakochev Scales of Existence. You now matter. You now...|
The voice stopped midway before it continued.
|Error.|
HUUM!
|Error.|
There was a long pause as Noah stared with stern eyes, and then...
|Vakochev has grown aware of an Anomalous entrant in THE Scales of Existence.|
BOOM!
|Vakochev welcomes the challenge.|
BOOM!
With a burst of brilliance, the voice and its majestic brilliance faded.
Noah’s eyes pulsed as his existence buzzed. His expression grew heavy.
Vakochev?
Vakochev?!

chapters.title: Chapter 4662: THE! III
paragraphs: The name pulsed in his mind again and again as he did not think much of it when he heard it the first time!
But to have a voice resound and speak it to him...was this something that occured for everyone that arrived inTHE Level One Scale of Existence?
Because that was a welcome.
Naturally, a welcome was something which would be given to everyone!
He wondered aboutTHE Vakochev Scales of Existenceand what that voice meant as his existence continued to buzz.
Vakochevwas affirmed to be a being. Shockingly, they had gotten their name onTHE Scales of Existencethemselves.
How grand were they? How immense were they? And what about him was considered anomalous forVakochevto extend a challenge?
Were THE Creature, THE Living Paradox, and others of their caliber also considered Anomalous in the same manner as him?
As he was thinking about all of these things...
|Notification: Claim on The First Tongue has been registered across Observable Existence.|
|After laying claim to The First Tongue, you now need to find and claim THE Axioms of The Oldest Paradox of Existence.|
|THE Axioms of Observable Existence.|
|Historical Context: At the moment Observable Existence differentiated, four aspects collided and separated simultaneously. Chaos. Existence. Paradox. The First Tongue.|
|This collision was violent beyond comprehension. Reality itself screamed into being.|
|And in that scream, fragments of pure conceptual truth broke off from each aspect and scattered across the newly born Observable Existence.|
|These are Axioms of Observable Existence.|
|They are living truths. Sentient fundamentals. The building blocks of reality that gained awareness at the moment of differentiation.|
|The Answer to The Oldest Paradox of Existence may be given by the one who holds the most power, or the most Axioms of Observable Existence.|
|There may be no difference between the two.|
BOOM!
The prompts were blazing with information as Noah looked at them with shining eyes while repeating the words.
"THE Axioms of Observable Existence..."
What the fuck was this now?
First The First Tongue. ThenTHE Vakochev Scales. Now Axioms that were apparently fragments of the four aspects that made up The Oldest Paradox of Existence.
Every time he thought he understood the depth of Observable Existence, another layer revealed itself. Another system. Another truth. Another thing he needed to find, capture, or claim.
He wasn’t complaining. Not really. This was exactly what he loved about existence. The endless discovery! The constant revelation that there was always more.
But still.
Axioms of Observable Existence. Living truths scattered across all of reality since the moment of differentiation.
How many were there? Where were they hidden? Who already possessed them?
The questions burned in his mind, but he didn’t have answers. Not yet.
What he did have was another objective.

Find and claim THE Axioms of Observable Existence! In addition to surviving The Fallout, going against Paradox, Elemental, and potentially THE Creature, endlessly forging his Foundation, and progress further in his Way In the First Tongue.
It was...light fucking work!
Far from The Infiniverse.
In the Lands of The Dead.
After obtaining control of the Disciples ofTHE Creature, The Great Usurper continued his idle expansion. But this time, it was with purpose.

The Disciples seemed to hold a great deal of knowledge of unique places. He simply directed his mass of invisible consciousness to flow that way, and he moved even faster than light across the Lands of the Dead.
He crossed domains of utter wonders with the Disciples forging the way forward.

Regions where death had crystallized into geometric patterns of impossible beauty. Regions where the silence was so profound it had become a physical force. Regions where the concept of ending had manifested as landscapes of perpetual twilight.
All of it fascinating. None of it his destination.
After some time, they arrived in a region that held orderly white and obsidian river passageways.
River Passageways.

The Great Usurper found these to be unique. The rivers didn’t flow with water. They flowed with something else. Authority, perhaps. Or maybe pure order given liquid form. White streams intertwined with obsidian currents in patterns that seemed random but weren’t.
Only the Disciples knew exactly which rivers to jump on and when to jump to another in order to arrive at an extremely isolated domain that they had passed through exactly once.
Without worrying about the consequences, The Great Usurper commanded the three Disciples ofTHE Creatureto enter these rivers.
With pristine order and care, they jumped sequentially one after another at exactly precise timings.
First Disciple: White river, third branch, seven seconds.
Second Disciple: Obsidian current, crossing junction, three seconds.
Third Disciple: White-obsidian confluence, diving deep, instantaneous.
And then they disappeared.
The moment they did, The Great Usurper felt his consciousness expanding once more as...
|Discovery Registered.|
|You have discovered a portion of the Early Veiled Shore of THE Creature.|
|Warning: This domain contains authority far exceeding your current existence.|
|Proceed with extreme caution.|
BOOM!
With such a grand introduction, The Great Usurper found his senses expanding out rapidly as he captured an utterly glorious continental landscape.

The horizon stretched endlessly with golden sands that seemed to drink in light and radiate warmth simultaneously. Not the harsh gold of desert heat, but the rich gold of something precious. Something alive. Something that had been cultivated with care beyond mortal comprehension.

Unfathomably tall trees stretched out for light years. Their trunks were wider than planets. Their branches spread across dimensions. Their leaves rustled with sounds that weren’t sounds but meanings. Each tree was its own ecosystem, its own world, its own truth.
And the entire place was filled with a terrifying concentration ofTHE Civilizational Authority.

The authority of the being who had shaped Observable Existence itself. The authority of the one who had given away his Everythings (supposedly) and still remained the most influential force in all of reality.
Even as a fragment of his former domain, the Early Veiled Shore radiated power that made The Great Usurper’s consciousness tremble.
But more than all of this...
As The Great Usurper sent the Disciples ofTHE Creaturefurther in...
As his idle existence continued to spread in this unfathomable domain...
His entire existence buzzed and almost spazzed out as if it came across something far too pristine.
Because in the midst of two unfathomably tall trees, there was an object.

It seemed to be half-covered by golden sands. But it shone with a dim obsidian-gold allure that called to something deep within his consciousness. Something primal. Something that recognized what it was looking at even before the prompts confirmed it.
When The Great Usurper focused on it...
|ALERT: EXTREME DANGER DETECTED.|
|You have discovered the Fourth Fragment of The Axiom of Primordial Paradox.|
|Classification: Origin Axiom Fragment.|
|The Axiom of Primordial Paradox grants absolute authority over contradiction itself.|
|The holder can make anything impossible possible, and anything possible impossible.|
|Current Status: Dormant.|
|WARNING: You are too weak to even gaze upon it.|
|Just for this observation, half of your Weavings of Existence have been used up.|
|Seriously, stop looking at it.|
|If you wake it and it poses THE Question to you, which you will be unable to answer, your entire existence could very well unravel.|
|LOOK AWAY.|
BOOM!
The Great Usurper was shocked as he sensed immense weakness in his existence.
Half of his Weavings. Gone. Just from looking at the thing.

He had come across the Early Veiled Shore ofTHE Creatureusing his Disciples, and there seemed to be utterly terrifying things in this place. Things that could destroy him without even trying. Things that existed on a level so far above him that his mere observation was an offense punishable by existential erosion.
He immediately pulled his consciousness back from the object. The obsidian-gold allure faded as distance grew between them, but the damage was done. Half his Weavings. Consumed by a single glance.
The Fourth Fragment of The Axiom of Primordial Paradox!
What...the hell was this thing?!

As his idle existence continued to spread in this unfathomable domain...
His entire existence buzzed and almost spazzed out as if it came across something far too pristine.
Because in the midst of two unfathomably tall trees, there was an object.
It seemed to be half-covered by golden sands.
But it shone with a dim obsidian-gold allure that called to something deep within his consciousness.
Something primal.
Something that recognized what it was looking at even before the prompts confirmed it.
When The Great Usurper focused on it...
|ALERT: EXTREME DANGER DETECTED.|
|You have discovered the Fourth Fragment of The Axiom of Primordial Paradox.|
|Classification: Origin Axiom Fragment.|
|The Axiom of Primordial Paradox grants absolute authority over contradiction itself.|
|The holder can make anything impossible possible, and anything possible impossible.|
|Current Status: Dormant.|
|WARNING: You are too weak to even gaze upon it.|
|Just for this observation, half of your Weavings of Existence have been used up.|
|Seriously, stop looking at it.|
|If you wake it and it poses THE Question to you, which you will be unable to answer, your entire existence could very well unravel.|
|LOOK AWAY.|
BOOM!
The Great Usurper was shocked as he sensed immense weakness in his existence.
Half of his Weavings.
Gone.
Just from looking at the thing.
He had come across the Early Veiled Shore ofTHE Creatureusing his Disciples, and there seemed to be utterly terrifying things in this place.
Things that could destroy him without even trying.
Things that existed on a level so far above him that his mere observation was an offense punishable by existential erosion.
He immediately pulled his consciousness back from the object.
The obsidian-gold allure faded as distance grew between them, but the damage was done.
Half his Weavings.
Consumed by a single glance.
The Fourth Fragment of The Axiom of Primordial Paradox!
What...the hell was this thing?!

chapters.title: Chapter 4663: THE! IV
paragraphs: Mysteries were infuriating.
They gnawed at the mind like parasites. They kept one awake during moments that should have been restful. They whispered questions without answers and dangled truths just out of reach.

From a certain perspective, mysteries were the cruelest aspect of existence. They reminded everyone that knowledge was incomplete. That understanding was always partial. That no matter how much one learned, there would always be something hidden, something obscured, something deliberately kept in shadow.

Some entities spent their entire existences chasing mysteries only to die with more questions than they started with. Some went mad from the pursuit. Some simply gave up and accepted ignorance as a form of peace.
Some would say that mysteries were existence’s way of mocking those who sought truth. A reminder that the Existence owed no explanations to anyone. That reality was under no obligation to make sense.
And yet.
As much as some hated mysteries, they kept existence churning.
Because that pristine moment when everything comes together. When every little piece fits a larger puzzle. When the fog lifts and the truth stands undeniable before you...oh!
That was a moment that could give a high even the strongest drugs could not replicate.
It made all the frustration worth it. All the sleepless nights. All the maddening speculation. All the dead ends and false leads and moments of despair.
One moment of truth could redeem a lifetime of confusion.
And that was why mysteries, despite being infuriating, were also beautiful.
Noah loved to solve mysteries.

He routinely thought aboutTHE Creature and THE Primordial Chaos and THE Living Paradoxand how all of them fit in the Weavings of this Observable Existence. The connections between them. The conflicts that stretched back to the moment of differentiation. The truths that had been hidden beneath layers of legend and misinformation.
When the pieces came together, and they eventually did, the satisfaction was immense.
Not long ago, he only knew the legends and the Stories of the Earliest Folds. Vague tales of primordial conflicts and ancient powers. Names spoken with reverence but little understanding.
Since then, he had uncovered the truth of what truly happened all those eons ago.

He knew about Ginnungagap. AboutTHE Creature, THE Primordial Chaos, and Temporal.About the coming ofTHE Living Existences and the creation of THE Loom.About the betrayals and alliances and schemes that had shaped everything.
Not all of it. Not yet. But more than he had known before.
So everything eventually would be solved.
Because at this moment, as he was thinking about many things, he was looking at the Principles of Existence that had helped get him exactly to where he was right now.
They were being elevated to the Genesis Stage.
To a Philology of The First Tongue.

Perpetual Harvest and The Cheating Architect were the first. They had already transcended their previous forms and become something grander. Living expressions of The First Tongue woven into the very fabric of his existence.

After the Logos of his other three Principles were broken down, their meaning and what they stood for seemed to be more inclined with Undifferentiated Mana. Their workings would likely fall under that umbrella and allow Noah to obtain more of their benefits through Undifferentiated Mana itself.
Sometimes having too many concepts and abilities did not mean strength.
Making things simpler led to even greater power.
Consolidation over accumulation. Unity over multiplicity! One perfect tool instead of a hundred mediocre ones.
As he was doing all of this, he looked over to the entity opposite him.
THE Infiniverse.

Her entire body was currently filled with swirling Logos of The First Tongue. They spiraled through her form like galaxies being born, each one a perfect expression of meaning given structure. An air of power buzzed around her that seemed heavy and terrifying for evenTHE Surface Depth of Absolute Sovereignty.
She was transforming and becoming something that matched his own elevation!
Noah asked her lightly, "How is everything proceeding?"
THE Infiniverseopened her eyes.
They looked like multicolored jewels, like colors that held meaning and colors that were themselves a form of language.

"For me, it is different," she said. Her voice was calm and imposing, resonating with authority that came from being the literal foundation of a Primordial Civilization."I am the object of The Civilization. I am the actual construct that supports your Civilization. So I gain the boons since you have advanced your Way and your Civilization."
She paused, her jeweled eyes shimmering with contemplation.

"But I also gain the boons from myself. Because I, as a construct that has consciousness, am also experiencing the elevation into the Depths of Absolute Sovereignty. Since I house countless Universes, Existential Domains, Omniverses, Wheels of Existence, and budding Transcendent Folds... all of these are now being elevated from a lower Scale of Existence to reach THE Level One Scale of Existence."
Her hands moved as she spoke, twirling seamlessly with Logos of The First Tongue. The letters formed and dissolved around her fingers like living things responding to her will.

"When this transformation is complete, THE Infiniverse will not be like it was before. Whatever happens on the outside with The Fallout, I will be able to elevate the inside of myself to eventually exceed even THE Loom."
Her expression held quiet confidence.
"Unless that construct is also similar to me. Unless it also has a consciousness. Which I doubt."
Noah smiled and nodded at her words.
THE Loomwas impressive. A structure that housedTHE Living Existencesand their domains.
But it was built by others. Designed by committee. A collaborative effort between beings with conflicting interests.
The Infiniverse was his. Built from his authority and grown from his Civilization. Animated by consciousness that was loyal to him absolutely.
That made all the difference.

He looked at the blue-gold illusory figure of Ruination, who was also being elevated. Her form seemed more solid than before. More real. As if the advancement intoTHEwas granting her greater substance in addition to greater power.
Even before he asked, she answered.

"My computational abilities,"Ruination said. Her voice was calm but held undertones of something that might have been wonder. Or perhaps concern. "Well, they are entering a scale where things seem a bit scary, even for me."
She paused, processing her own advancement with the same analytical precision she applied to everything else.
"But the summary of it is that I can take care of quite literally everything for you. If you give me the permission to, I may even be able to do it faster than you could yourself."
Her illusory form flickered with cascading data streams as she continued.

"Decoding and elevating your Principles. Designing your own Core Phonemes. Monitoring and increasing the Logos and Phonemes running across your body and refining your existence. Writing more on and expanding the Chapters of THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons. Increasing your Mastery of The First Tongue with constant practice. Monitoring THE Infinite Desmoterion."
She wasn’t finished.

"I can even take over one of your bodies and perform the teaching duties in the Early Veiled Shore. Laying out THE Faraday Cage. Handling the new Civilization Specializations. And I have already begun a database for THE Axioms of Observable Existence. If any Weavings relating to them are mentioned across the Folds and Wandering Territories, I will detect them."
Her jeweled eyes met his directly.
"I could basically do everything for Master, should you give me the permission to do so."
Her words were filled with brilliance.
Noah smiled even more after he heard them. When he thought about the many things she could do, possibilities unfolded like flowers blooming in accelerated time.
He began giving her directions on which things she could directly get started on.
"Handle the elevation of remaining Principles into Philologies. Coordinate with THE Infiniverse on Faraday Cage placement. Continue the database for Axioms..."
Ruination absorbed each instruction with perfect precision.

"Maintain passive refinement of my existence through continuous Phoneme and Logos circulation. Expand THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons with new insights as they emerge. Monitor THE Infinite Desmoterion and advancements from it..."
More instructions. More delegation. More efficiency!
After all, efficiency was key in existence. All the countless background processes of advancement could be taken care of while he continued to unceasingly move forward.
Existence was a struggle and almost always unfair.
But he had the tools to cheat existence and make the playing field tilt slightly to his favor.
Others had to do everything themselves.
But what was a Civilization? It was not singular. It was made up of many!
So he would put the many to work. He would even put Tor and THE Living Origin and The First Farmer to work!
Everything working together. Everything contributing to his advancement.Everything tilting the playing field in his direction!

chapters.title: Chapter 4664: Surprise I
paragraphs: In that unique space filled with extremely pure blue-gold Primus Mana, Noah allowed Ruination to take care of many things as he focused on himself.

He felt the weight and immensity ofTHE Intermediate Depth of Absolute Sovereigntyas the process of his Way and Civilization advancing was a gradual one that continued to unfold with each passing moment.
He was getting new changes and being exposed to new prompts every now and then as different aspects of himself surprised him and made unique advancements that he hadn’t anticipated.

In his entrance toTHE Level One Scale of Existenceand even a bit before it, he had gotten a great deal of titles and distinctions likeTHE Genesis Monarch of Infinite Lexicons, THE Potentate, and THE Anomaly. Even he himself had declared how he was Mana, THE Mana, THE Infinite Mana, and THE First Tongue!
But even though he had declared all those grand distinctions, the last one felt like an empty title, something that he shouted out but didn’t truly receive or embody.
Because if he truly wasTHE First Tongue,boy oh boy would he feel different now.
How crazy was it if he truly wasTHE First Tongueitself? Would he not then be able to control a significant portion of Observable Existence?

No, he didn’t fully and truly embodyTHE First Tongueas for now he hadlaid a claimon it and was working toward truly embodying it. The day where he fully and truly embodiedTHE First Tonguemay be the day he could look atTHE Creature, the fucking guy who could cause him existential damage just from prolonged staring and exposure when he was in Ginnungagap.
The next time he met this entity, he wanted to be able to look and do whatever he wanted while having the power to at least stand opposite him.
As much as the possibility was there that this entity might be an enemy against him, Noah’s intuition was actually leaning on the other side becauseTHE Creaturefelt too complex to simply be an enemy.

Well,THE Living Paradox and THE Primordial Chaoswere complex on their own with unknown motivations and machinations, but his intuition towardTHE Creaturewas different in ways he couldn’t fully articulate.

The decisions ofTHE Creaturecould be questioned, but when it came to all the things that Noah’s human psychology would consider bad or evil, there weren’t truly much to point to.THE Creatureimprisoned all the entities in the Infinite Unfurling, but wasn’t Noah imprisoning entities right now in his Infinite Desmoterion?

He smiled at the parallel as maybe he had some sort of bias when it came toTHE Creaturebecause this being also had their own machinations, and he kept thinking about what he would have been forced to resort to or what could have happened ifTHE Creaturehad not intervened in Ginnungagap.

THE Creaturelent him a hand since his actions helped Existence itself, but how much more wouldTHE Creaturecontinue to help him when the last thing that this being did was not listen to The Dead Order’s demand to collapse him?
That was significant and meaningful in ways that suggestedTHE Creaturewas not his enemy, not yet anyways.
As he was thinking about all of this...
"Oh?"

He blinked as he received new waves of information that weren’t from prompts or a ridiculous voice welcoming him toTHE Vakochev Scales of Existence, but was actually a message from Malphas. His very hardworking butler had actually made a finding and reached out to him right away.

The finding related toThe Primordial Early Excavation Depthsthat he had gained access to in what seemed like forever ago in his Early Veiled Shore, but it was merely weeks since then as time moved strangely when every day brought apocalyptic revelations and existential advancements.

The Primordial Early Excavation Depths were dimensional mines that extended into collapsed fragments of the Earliest Folds, containing resources that no longer existed anywhere else in the current Observable Existence like Ore of Early Resonance, Crystallized Temporal Fragments, Memory Stones, Essence Gems, Paradox Minerals, and Structural Marrow.
All of it was buried in depths that stretched infinitely downward, guarded by Remnant Lifeforms from collapsed Shores who may be Living, may be Dead, or somewhere in between.
When the depths first unlocked, the volunteer Malphas lead the way to clear levels, gather resources, and explore what secrets the collapsed Earliest Folds still held.

Malphas had been diligent in this task as he cleared level after level with systematic precision, gathering resources that flowed into the Early Veiled Shore’s development while encountering Remnant Lifeforms and dispatching them with the cold efficiency that made him such an effective butler.

But he had never called out to Noah directly, not when he found rare ores, not when he discovered Memory Stones containing techniques from deceased Early Creatures, and not when environmental hazards tested the limits of his existence.
Malphas handled everything himself because that was his nature and that was his pride.
So for him to call out now meant something significant had occurred.

Noah focused on the message and learned that Malphas had arrived on the one hundredth level, the deepest level currently available and the threshold beyond which the depths would only unlock as the Shore continued evolving.
And it seemed like he had come across an immensity there, something significant enough that even Malphas with all his capability and self-sufficiency felt the need to inform his master immediately.
Noah’s eyes sparkled as he said, "Let’s go take a look..."
Well, even though he said that, another body was already arriving before the entrance of the depths!

The Primordial Early Excavation Depths currently manifested as a massive chasm in the golden sands of the Early Veiled Shore with its edges lined with crystallized authority that shimmered with colors from eras long past while the air around it hummed with the weight of collapsed history.
Noah’s body descended into the depths without hesitation as the journey downward was swift with each level flashing past him in moments. Level 10, Level 30, Level 50, Level 75.

The environment grew stranger as he descended because reality became less stable and the walls of the mine shifted between states of existence, sometimes solid, sometimes ethereal, and sometimes something in between.
Remnant Lifeforms watched from shadows but did not approach as they recognized power far beyond their own and chose survival over confrontation.
Level 90, Level 95, Level 99.
And then Level 100.
Noah emerged into a vast cavern that shouldn’t have been able to exist because its dimensions were paradoxical and its atmosphere held the weight of eons compressed into a single space.

Malphas stood at the center with his butler attire immaculate despite the journey through a hundred levels of collapsed reality, and his expression was composed but his eyes held something Noah rarely saw in his most capable servant, which was uncertainty.
"Master," Malphas said while bowing slightly, "I apologize for the interruption to your cultivation, but I believe you need to see this yourself."
He gestured toward something behind him.

And Noah’s eyes widened because embedded in the wall of the hundredth level, half-buried in crystallized fragments of the Earliest Folds, was something, well, someone, that he absolutely never expected to see!
